src: 用空气来洗手，哈口气判断疾病，精确搜寻雾霾来源 昨天晚上，在浙江大学2016年学术年会开幕式上，一系列脑洞大开的学术成果获得表彰。

chosen.text: Using air to wash hands, breathing to diagnose diseases, and precise search for sources of smog. Last night, at the opening ceremony of Zhejiang University's 2016 Academic Year Conference, a series of groundbreaking academic achievements were recognized.

src: 这些成果的主要研究者都是学生，研究覆盖了环境、机械、能源、医疗、生命科学、人文教育等各大领域，同学们从一个好奇的点子开始，创造出了许多具有应用价值的高端发明，其中一些项目已在国内国际获奖。

chosen.text: The main researchers behind these achievements were students, covering major fields such as environment, mechanical engineering, energy, medicine, life sciences, and humanities education. Students began with a curious idea and created many high-end inventions with practical applications, some of which have won awards domestically and internationally.

src: 生物传感器：你的家庭体检医生

chosen.text: Biological sensors: Your home doctor for health checks

src: 生物医学工程学院博士生张迪鸣团队现场展示了一个智能手机端的生物传感器，大小只有智能手机的一半。

chosen.text: The team of ZHANG Diming, a doctoral student from the School of Biomedical Engineering, showcased a biosensor on-site that fits on half the size of a smartphone.

src: “你只需要轻轻呼一口气，这套仪器就能从你呼出的气体成分中，初步检测身体健康状况 。 ”

chosen.text: "You simply need to exhale gently, and this instrument can preliminarily detect your health condition based on the components in your exhaled gases."

src: 张迪鸣介绍说，这套传感器与智能手机相连，呼出气体后，健康报告就会显示在手机上。

chosen.text: Zhang Diming explains that this sensor connects to a smartphone, and after exhaling, a health report will display on the phone.

src: 市场上能够检测健康状况的智能手环，一般检测的是温度、脉搏等物理参数。

chosen.text: Smart watches that can detect health conditions usually monitor physical parameters such as temperature and pulse on the market.

src: 而这套生物传感器运用了石墨烯这种新型材料，它的目标物是化学元素，敏锐的“嗅觉”让它能更深度、准确地体现身体健康状况。

chosen.text: And this biosensor leverages graphene, a novel material, with its target being chemical elements. Its keen "sense of smell" allows it to more deeply and accurately reflect one’s health condition.

src: 智能手术灯：医生的高能眼睛

chosen.text: Intelligent Operating Room Lights: Doctors' High-Energy Eyes

src: 除了智能手机，手术室里也用起了智能手术灯。

chosen.text: Besides smartphones, smart operating lights are also used in the operating room.

src: 这项发明在今年第44届瑞士日内瓦国际发明展中获得银奖。

chosen.text: This invention won a silver award at the 44th International Exhibition of Inventions of Switzerland in Geneva this year.

src: 光电科学与工程学院硕士生朱林靖、申俊飞团队在传统手术灯的缺陷中开启了新思路，发明了智能LED手术无影灯。

chosen.text: The master's student team from the School of Optoelectronic Science and Engineering, Zhu Linjing and Shen Junfei, opened up new ideas in the shortcomings of traditional operating lamps and invented an intelligent LED operating shadowless lamp.

src: “很多疾病早期检测、切除不到位，跟医生手术室用的灯有关 。 ”

chosen.text: Many early disease detection and removal are inadequate because of the lights doctors use in the operating room.

src: 申俊飞说，比如癌症早期检查时，医生如果不能及时看清所有肿瘤组织，那么之后癌细胞还会扩散。

chosen.text: Shen Junfei says that during early cancer screenings, if doctors cannot clearly see all tumor tissues in time, cancer cells will spread later on.

src: 这种智能手术灯有四个灯盘，通过调节光谱，来增强不同组织在光照下的区别度。

chosen.text: This intelligent surgical lamp has four light discs that adjust the spectrum to enhance the distinguishability of different tissues under illumination.

src: 在手术过程中，医生可以根据手术需要和个人习惯，随时调节光斑的大小、光亮程度、光谱、颜色均匀性以及无影率。

chosen.text: During surgery, doctors can adjust the size, brightness, spectrum, color uniformity, and shadowless rate of the light spot as needed and according to their personal preference at any time.

src: 这种智能手术灯已经在浙江大学医学院附属邵逸夫医院、浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院等医院试用，得到较好的反馈。

chosen.text: This intelligent operating lamp has been piloted in hospitals such as Zhejiang University School of Medicine Affiliated Shǒuyífu Hospital and Zhejiang University School of Medicine Affiliated Children's Hospital, receiving good feedback.

src: 去年十月，这项发明获得国家挑战杯一等奖。

src: 用空气洗手：省水又酷炫

chosen.text: Washing hands with air: Saves water and is cool and trendy

src: 普通人洗手就是用水冲，顶多擦点肥皂，挤点洗手液，而李启章等同学则发明了一套“空气洗手装置 ” 。

chosen.text: Ordinary people wash their hands by rinsing them with water, at most rubbing some soap and squeezing some hand sanitizer, while Li Qizhang and his classmates invented an "air washing device."

src: 只要站上装置的洗手台，我们的体重就能将空气压缩而出。

chosen.text: Standing on the sink of the device, our weight can compress the air out.

src: “就像是一个打气筒。

chosen.text: It's like a pump.

src: 压缩出的空气，在水龙头处形成流体，和水结合在一起。

chosen.text: The compressed air forms a fluid at the faucet and combines with water.

src: 这样，我们就能把手洗干净啦 ！ ”

chosen.text: So, we can wash our hands now! ”

src: 显色反应和细菌残留实验证明：通过这种方法洗手的效果，和普通的洗手方法是一样的。

chosen.text: The color reaction and bacterial residue test prove that the effectiveness of washing hands this way is the same as that of regular handwashing methods.

src: 这个装置只需要依靠我们自身的重力作为驱动，既能保证洗净程度，又能节约90%的水，整个过程完全无能耗，节能环保。

chosen.text: This device relies solely on our own gravity as the driving force, ensuring cleaning efficiency while saving 90% of water. The entire process is completely energy-free and environmentally friendly.

src: 去年，在第二届全球重大挑战峰会中，这项发明在诸多世界顶尖名校中脱颖而出，获得唯一的金奖。

chosen.text: A certificate that feels very meaningful – an emergency rescue certificate

src: 这是我除了驾驶证之外一本觉得重要的技能证书之一！

chosen.text: This is one of the important skill certificates I value beyond my driver's license!

src: 普及一下：急救措施其实是做发生突发事件时候的应急救援，即在救护车来之前的抢救。

chosen.text: To clarify: first aid actually refers to emergency rescue measures during emergencies, i.e., the rescue conducted before the arrival of an ambulance.

src: 众所周知，在事故发生后救护车来的过程中其实是还有一段时间的，而正是这段时间才是最关键的。

chosen.text: It is well known that there is actually a period of time during which an ambulance arrives after an incident, and it is precisely this period that is most critical.

src: 这个时候便是需要急救的时候。

chosen.text: This is when emergency care is needed.

src: 如果我真的发生了心脏病、脑溢血、呼吸骤停，那么我们生命的窗口只有四分钟，黄金四分钟！

chosen.text: If I actually have a heart attack, cerebral hemorrhage, or sudden respiratory failure, then our window of life would be four minutes, golden four minutes!

src: 所以身边的人懂得急救是多么重要呀！

chosen.text: So knowing how to perform first aid is so important to those around you!

src: 当我们身边有人倒下的时候，我们可以通过专业的知识去对他进行抢救，而不是傻傻地站在那里一动不动什么也做不了，这种无助的感觉太让人感到可怕了。

chosen.text: When someone we know falls down, we can rescue them through professional knowledge rather than standing there helplessly doing nothing. The feeling of helplessness is terribly scary.

src: “在中国，我们官方数据每年有三百万人意外死亡，最危险的叫心脏骤停。

chosen.text: In China, we have official data indicating that 300,000 people die from unintentional deaths each year, the most dangerous of which is cardiac arrest.

src: 在美国全国是平均15%能救过来。

chosen.text: In the United States, on average, 15% survive.

src: 在拉斯维加斯的赌场酒店，百分之七八十能救过来，上海、北京低于1%。”

chosen.text: In Las Vegas casinos, about 70-80% can be saved, while in Shanghai and Beijing, it is below 1%.

src: 这是第一反应创始人陆乐说的。

chosen.text: This is what First Reaction founder Lu Le said.

src: 如果一个人发生了心脏骤停，呼吸没有了，心跳没有了，你掐人中是没有任何作用的。

chosen.text: If someone suffers a cardiac arrest with no breathing and no heartbeat, pressing on the point between the nose and mouth is ineffective.

src: 必须做人工呼吸、胸外按压才有可能把人救过来。

chosen.text: Only artificial respiration and external chest compressions can possibly save the person.

src: 我发现我们现在还很少人会有这种意识去学习急救，但是当事情发生的时候就来不及了，所以还是呼吁大家都去学习一下这个技能，让我们在面对突发状况的时候能够及时作出反应。

chosen.text: I've found that we still have very few people with this awareness to learn first aid, but it's too late when something happens, so I still urge everyone to learn this skill so that we can respond promptly in case of emergencies.

src: 说不定还能挽救一个人的生命！

chosen.text: It might even save someone's life!

chosen.text: But to say that this movie has nothing remarkable about it would be incorrect, at least the soundtrack was well chosen.

chosen.text: Rotten films come in many varieties, some that make you fall asleep comfortably at the cinema and others that leave you incensed after watching them. "Four Sea" is like a monkey on Emei Mountain to viewers—it can set your anger aflame in countless ways.

src: 在侮辱观众这点上，韩寒真的是天赋绝伦。

chosen.text: In terms of insulting the audience, Han Ge is truly gifted.

src: 这部片子最让人感到痛苦的就是它仿佛是克系小说里的造物，难以名状，漏洞多的就像是小马哥身上的风衣。

chosen.text: What's most painful about this film is that it feels like a creation from a K-drama, indescribable, with as many flaws as Michael Kwan's jacket.

src: 甚至看完后你会怀疑这里面是否有导演暗含的隐喻，但当你仔细思考之后发现它其实就是一坨屎。

chosen.text: Even after watching it, you might wonder if there is an underlying metaphor from the director, but upon closer thought, you realize it’s just a pile of feces.

src: 先简单的说下我很难理解的一些情节。

chosen.text: Her grandmother wished to see snow, and the plot arranged for an elderly man in the neighborhood to drive her in a small van to northeast to see it snow.

src: 高龄老人坐着面包车从南方到东北看雪？？

src: 岛上飞车党小混混为什么能轻轻松松就把一段山路做到封路？？

src: 然后路中间送钢筋的卡车就停在路边，四周连卡车司机都找不到。

chosen.text: Then the truck delivering rebar in the middle of the road stopped by the side of the road, and even the truck driver couldn't be found around.

src: 这道具感也太明显了吧。

chosen.text: An adult who knows how to use a smartphone but doesn’t know how to use a room key to open the door in a hotel, and ends up forcing his way into a room without finding the hotel manager, sitting outside the door all night?

src: 这种莫名其妙的情节充斥在整个影片里，由于情节过于离谱以至于我回忆它们时都会令我感到痛苦。

chosen.text: This inexplicable plot permeates the entire film, and its absurdity is so extreme that recalling it causes me pain.

src: 除了情节外，更糟糕的是电影的主旨，或者说这电影根本没有主旨，就是一个面目可憎的缝合怪。

chosen.text: Beyond the plot, even worse is the film’s message, or rather, the film itself has no clear message at all, being a repulsive patchwork creature.

src: 影片开头你会以为他想拍个喜剧片，20多分钟后你猜它也许是个励志片，看一半时你觉得它可能是个想体现小镇青年生存不易的剧情片，看完后你就压根也不知道自己究竟看了个啥，随之而来的是对自己深深的怀疑，大过年的为什么要跑到电影院去欣赏大便。

chosen.text: At first, you think it's a comedy, but about 20 minutes in, you wonder if it might be an inspirational film. By halfway through, you think it may be a drama about how tough it is for town youth to survive. After watching it, you have no idea what you just saw, and this leads to deep self-doubt: why go to the cinema on New Year's Day to appreciate such excrement.

src: 对于大部分人来说其实也都非常熟悉各类电影的套路了，比如你要想拍摩托车手，那就励志＋喜剧然后告诉观众一个有天赋的菜鸟是如何一步步走向成功的。

chosen.text: For most people, the plot of the film is very familiar, for example, if you want to shoot a motorcyclist, it's a motivational+comedy and then you tell the audience how a talented bird moves step by step towards success.

src: 如果你想拍爱情片，那你就老老实实讲喜欢骑摩托的小镇青年和服务员妹子之间的恩怨纠葛。

chosen.text: If you want to make a love story, then just openly talk about the conflicts between the townsfolk who like riding motorcycles and the waitress girl.

src: 如果你想反映现实，那最起码你的情节不能出现和正常世界相悖的东西。

chosen.text: A role like the one played by Yin Zheng, where a new motorcycle he just got burned is still able to sing, cannot go into some ridiculous imaginings even Kennedy would find hard to stomach.

src: 至于女主明明不是弱智可在某些方面表现的就像个5岁小孩，我真不知道这是演技的原因还是导演的要求。

chosen.text: As for the female lead, who is clearly not dumb but behaves like a 5-year-old in certain aspects, I'm not sure if it's due to her acting or the director's requirements.

src: 还有一点我也挺想不明白，韩寒作为一个赛车手为什么这么热衷于在他自己的电影里添加撞车情节？

chosen.text: One thing I still don't understand is why Han Han, as a race car driver, is so enthusiastic about adding crash scenes in his own films?

chosen.text: Chongqing vocational colleges pilot modern apprenticeship system; students are de facto employees of the enterprise upon enrollment - Xinhua News Agency

src: 昨天，记者从市教委获悉，今年起，我市将在60所中职学校试点“现代学徒制”人才培养模式，接受试点培养的学生同时具备学徒身份，招生录入后将被试点企业预录为单位员工。

chosen.text: Yesterday, it was reported that this year, modern apprenticeship training models will be piloted in 60 vocational high schools in the city, with students participating in the pilot simultaneously holding the status of apprentices. After enrollment, these students will be preliminarily recruited as employees by the pilot enterprises.

src: 市教委要求，规范中职学校招生录取和企业用工程序，明确学徒的中职学校学生和企业准员工双重身份，按照双向选择原则，学徒、学校和企业签订三方协议，对于年满16周岁未达到18周岁的学徒，须由学徒、监护人、学校和企业四方签订协议，确定各方权益及学徒在岗培养的具体岗位、教学内容、权益保障等。

chosen.text: The municipal education commission requires that enrollment procedures for vocational and technical schools and enterprise hiring programs be standardized, clarifying the dual identity of apprentice students at vocational and technical schools and prospective employees from enterprises. Apprentices, schools, and enterprises should sign a tripartite agreement based on the principle of mutual selection. For apprentices who are aged 16 or older but under 18 years old, a quadrilateral agreement must be signed among the apprentice, guardian, school, and enterprise to determine each party's rights and responsibilities, as well as specific job positions, teaching content, and rights protection during their on-the-job training.

src: 鼓励试点学校采用现代学徒制形式与合作企业联合开展企业员工岗前培训和转岗培训。

chosen.text: Encourage pilot schools to adopt a modern apprenticeship model in collaboration with enterprises to conduct onboarding training and job-transition training for enterprise employees.

src: 试点学校要改革人才培养模式。

chosen.text: Pilot schools should reform their talent cultivation model.

src: 校企共同设计人才培养方案，共同制订专业教学标准、课程标准、岗位标准、企业师傅标准、质量监控标准及相应实施方案。

chosen.text: Collaborate to design talent cultivation plans, jointly establish professional teaching standards, curriculum standards, job standards, standards for enterprise mentors, quality supervision standards, and corresponding implementation schemes.

src: 试点以培养学制为一个试点周期，学生在企业的实习时间根据专业人才培养方案确定，顶岗实习一般为6个月。

chosen.text: The pilot program runs for an academic cycle designed to cultivate students, during which the duration of internships at enterprises is determined according to the professional talent training plan. Full-time internships generally last for six months.

src: 在企业实践应实施企业班组化管理模式，根据不同专业的特点，1个师傅可带2～5个徒弟，组成学习小组，确保学生熟练掌握每个轮训岗位所需的技能。

chosen.text: Enterprise practice should implement an enterprise team-based management model, with each mentor taking on 2-5 apprentices based on their professional characteristics, forming learning groups to ensure that students master the skills required for each training position.

src: 根据安排，从2016年起到2019年8月，我市分三批确定60个市级中职现代学徒制试点，每个试点人数在50人左右，总共培养3000名左右学生（学徒 ） 。

chosen.text: According to the plan, from 2016 to August 2019, the city determined three batches of 60 municipal secondary vocational modern apprenticeship pilot programs, with each program enrolling around 50 students (apprentices) in total, resulting in the cultivation of about 3,000 students (apprentices).

src: 按照先试点再推行，由点到面逐步推进的原则，探索建立校企联合招生、联合培养、一体化育人的长效机制，切实提升学生岗位技能，提高学生对口就业率和就业质量。

src: 南非医生：奥密克戎传播力虽强 但多为轻症

chosen.text: South African doctor: While Omicron is highly transmissible, it tends to cause mild symptoms.

src: 南非许多医生和医疗专家认为，新冠病毒奥密克戎变种所致病症比德尔塔变种更为轻微，虽然传播速度更快。

chosen.text: Many doctors and medical experts in South Africa believe that the symptoms caused by the Omicron variant of COVID-19 are less severe than those caused by the Delta variant, although it spreads faster.

src: 据美联社报道，随着奥密克戎变种在南非的传播，南非豪登省的一个五千多名医生组成医师组织报告说，他们目前治疗的新冠病人出现的症状都比较轻微，例如身体疼痛和咳嗽等与流感类似的症状。

chosen.text: According to an Associated Press report, as the Omicron variant spreads in South Africa, a physicians' organization comprising more than 5,000 doctors from Gauteng province reported that patients they are currently treating for COVID-19 are experiencing relatively mild symptoms, such as body aches and coughing, which are similar to those of the flu.

src: 该组织总监安本·皮莱（Unben Pillay）医生说，他每天都要看几十名病人，但是还没有任何病人需要住院。

chosen.text: Dr. Unben Pillay, the director of the organization, says he sees dozens of patients every day, but none require hospitalization.

src: 皮莱说 ： “ 他们能够在家里控制疾病，大多数人在隔离10至14天内康复 。 ”

chosen.text: Peele said: "They can control the disease at home, with most people recovering within 10 to 14 days of isolation."

src: 他说，这包括老年患者和那些有健康问题的患者，这些人群本来更容易因冠状病毒感染而陷入重症。

chosen.text: He said it includes elderly patients and those with health issues, groups that are typically more vulnerable to becoming critically ill from COVID-19 infections.

src: 他说，与之相比，在上一波的德尔塔疫情中，他治疗的新冠患者“呼吸困难，血氧水平低。

chosen.text: He says that compared to the previous wave of the Delta outbreak, the COVID patients he treated were “short of breath and had low oxygen levels.”

src: 许多人几天内就要住院 ” 。

chosen.text: Many need to be hospitalized in a few days.

src: 在南部非洲首次报告奥密克戎变异毒株后的两周内，其他医生也分享了类似的经验。

chosen.text: Within two weeks of the first report of the Omicron variant in southern Africa, other doctors shared similar experiences.

src: 虽然收集足够的数据还需要几个星期的时间，但医生的观察和早期证据提供了一些线索。

chosen.text: While it will still take several weeks to collect enough data, doctors' observations and early evidence provide some clues.

src: 据南非国家传染病研究所总结：在近几周住院的新冠患者中，只有30%是严重病症，是前一波疫情重症比例的一半；平均住院时间从8天缩短到2.8天；近期的新冠患者中，仅有3%死亡，而在南非早期爆发的病例中，死亡比例达20 % 。

chosen.text: According to the National Institute for Communicable Diseases in South Africa: In the recent weeks, only 30% of hospitalized COVID patients have severe cases, half the proportion from the previous wave; the average hospital stay has been reduced from 8 days to 2.8 days; and recently infected patients have a death rate of just 3%, compared to a 20% fatality rate in early cases in South Africa.

src: 非洲健康研究所所长威廉·哈内科姆（Willem Hanekom）引用国家传染病研究所的数据和其他报告说 ： “ 目前，几乎所有的迹象都表明，这是一种较温和的疾病 。 ”

chosen.text: The head of Africa Health Research Institute, Willem Hanekom, cited data from the National Institute of Communicable Diseases and other reports to say: "Currently, almost all the indications point to this being a milder disease."

src: 他还说 ： “ 现在还是早期，我们需要获得后期数据。

chosen.text: He also said, "It is still early, and we need to obtain later data."

src: 通常情况下，住院和死亡发生的时间较晚，而我们进入这一波疫情的时间只有两周 。 ”

chosen.text: Usually, the onset of hospitalization and death occurs later, while we entered this wave of the pandemic only two weeks ago.”

src: 与此同时，世界各地的科学家正在观察病例数和住院率，同时测试目前的疫苗和治疗方法的效果。

chosen.text: Meanwhile, scientists around the world are observing case numbers and hospitalization rates while testing the efficacy of current vaccines and treatments.

src: 尽管德尔塔仍然是全世界主要的新冠病毒株，但奥密克戎病例正在数十个国家出现，其中南非为疫情中心。

chosen.text: While Delta remains the predominant coronavirus strain worldwide, Omicron cases are now appearing in dozens of countries, with South Africa at the epicenter of the outbreak.

src: 据卫生官员介绍，豪登省在12月的第一周发现的新病例增加了400 % ， 测试显示，奥密克戎变体的病例占90%以上。

chosen.text: According to health officials, the number of new cases detected in the first week of December in Gauteng has increased by 400%, with tests showing that over 90% of cases are attributed to the Omicron variant.

src: 教育时评:拯救被拐儿童要靠什么？

chosen.text: Education Comment: What Is Needed to Save Kidnapped Children?

src: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。

chosen.text: If we were to compare it to the famous anti-trafficking slogan "No Purchase, No Killing," in an environment where there is no demand for "reclaiming abducted children," through mass prevention and control and public anti-trafficking efforts, making trafficking activities unprofitable, risky, and costly, such crimes would not occur frequently.

src: 近日，公安部刑事侦查局打拐办开发的儿童失踪信息紧急发布平台上线。

chosen.text: Recently, the Missing Children Emergency Response Platform developed by the Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security went online.

src: 这是为建立儿童失踪信息发布的权威渠道、及时找回被拐儿童而创设的互联网信息平台。

chosen.text: This is an internet platform created to establish an authoritative channel for missing children information releases and promptly recover abducted children.

src: 听闻此App名为“团圆 ” ， 顿觉暖意十足。

chosen.text: Hearing that the app is called “ reunification, ” a sense of warmth instantly comes over me.

src: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺 ” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。

chosen.text: New technological means are not only named "cultural" and full of sentiment, but are also appropriately applied informatively, practical, and effective.

src: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。

chosen.text: Anti-trafficking law enforcement's primary goal is to recover abducted children and protect their safety and freedom.

src: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。

chosen.text: And then comes the trial and punishment of suspects.

src: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词 ” 。

chosen.text: The significance of criminal punishment ranges from individual punishment, social prevention, to legal education, and many "big words" could be cited.

src: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。

chosen.text: However, priority should be given to the safety of the victims before trafficking cases are solved.

src: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。

chosen.text: Issues should be prioritized based on urgency. Topics like whether kidnapping children should always be punishable by death, which are controversial and widely discussed, can be put on hold for careful discussion; however, rescuing abducted children cannot wait.

src: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。

chosen.text: Based on experience with such cases, traffickers tend to flee the crime scene as quickly as possible after committing the act.

src: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。

chosen.text: Every minute a search operation delays puts the child one step farther from their parents, increasing the difficulty of the case investigation by one degree.

src: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。

chosen.text: In this case, coming up with effective solutions like the “Couple Reunion” platform, which directly helps in solving cases and recovering children, is indeed pragmatic action.

src: 毕竟 ， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。

chosen.text: After all, "cracking down on trafficking" is a big task that requires the entire legal system to be put into operation.

src: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。

chosen.text: Combatting crime, safeguarding children and parents’ rights, from the improvement of legislation to judicial protection, and meticulous enforcement, all require the implementation of care for “protecting the young and the weak.”

src: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。

chosen.text: Moreover, better prevention of child trafficking, from families to society, is still possible.

src: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。

chosen.text: For instance, a common case is a family of three resting at the railway station, where the parents fall asleep and wake up to find the child missing.

src: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。

chosen.text: One cannot expect a two-year-old child to have sufficient self-protection skills, but as a parent of a young child, one should at least have a corresponding level of protective awareness.

src: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。

chosen.text: Alternating rest for both parents or placing children in safe custody are some of the most basic measures to prevent child abduction.

src: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。

chosen.text: From the other side of the police crackdown on trafficking crimes, those who buy trafficked children should also be concerned about and punished.

src: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。

chosen.text: A single illegal act is often just one link in a longer chain.

src: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。

chosen.text: According to China's Criminal Law, the statutory minimum sentence for the crime of trafficking in children is 5 years; in cases of particularly serious circumstances, it may be as high as death penalty with confiscation of property.

src: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。

chosen.text: With a high starting point and heavy maximum sentence, trafficking in children appears to be a crime with heavier penalties in an overall trend towards leniency.

src: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。

chosen.text: There are still many cases of trafficking occurring every year.

src: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。

chosen.text: It is evident that some people have outdated views on bringing up children and lack legal awareness.

src: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。

chosen.text: Legislative education should be synchronized for this group.

src: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。

chosen.text: To effectively control trafficking crimes, strict enforcement by the official authorities is not enough.

src: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。

chosen.text: If trafficking “markets” exist widely and traffickers are greedy for profit, constantly innovating their methods of trafficking to form a “game” with law enforcement, then anti-trafficking efforts will inevitably fall into an inefficient quagmire.

src: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。

chosen.text: Therefore, dispelling backward ideas and promoting legal knowledge can also help eradicate child trafficking and child buying crimes.

src: 湖南日报12月10日讯（全媒体记者 龚柏威）根据省委统一安排，12月10日上午，省委常委、省委宣传部部长杨浩东在马栏山视频文创园作互动宣讲，深入学习贯彻党的十九届六中全会精神，学习贯彻习近平总书记对湖南重要讲话重要指示批示精神，学习贯彻省第十二次党代会精神。

chosen.text: The Hunan Daily (December 10) – (Full-media reporter Gong Bawei) According to unified arrangements by the provincial Party committee, on the morning of December 10th, Cai Haodong, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Minister of Propaganda Department of the Provincial Party Committee, delivered an interactive lecture at Ma'an Mountain Video Cultural and Creative Park, deepening the study and implementation of the spirit of the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, President Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions concerning Hunan, and the spirit of the 12th Provincial Party Congress.

src: 杨浩东从理想信念与初心使命、自我革命与青春大党、党的领袖和党的理论等三个方面，结合自身感悟、亲身经历，深入浅出、全面系统地阐释了全会精神的核心要义和实践要求。

chosen.text: Yang Haodong expounded on the core essence and practical requirements of the spirit of the meeting from three perspectives: ideals and beliefs as well as the mission and responsibility, self-revolution and the youthful party, and the leading figures and theories of the Party, drawing upon his own insights and personal experiences to provide an accessible and comprehensive explanation.

src: 他指出，要将全会精神和习近平总书记对湖南重要讲话重要指示批示精神、省党代会精神结合起来学，融会贯通学，增强捍卫“两个确立 ” 、 做到“两个维护”的思想自觉、政治自觉、行动自觉，坚定不移沿着习近平总书记指引的方向前进。

chosen.text: He pointed out that one should combine the spirit of the plenary session with Comrade Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions on Hunan, the spirit of the provincial Party congress, and study them integrally to enhance the ideological, political, and action-oriented consciousness in safeguarding “two establishments” and upholding “two maintenances.” One should proceed unwaveringly along the direction indicated by Comrade Xi Jinping.

src: 在互动交流环节，基层干部代表、企业代表、青年代表就三个历史决议的关系、如何理解“两个确立”的决定性意义、文化企业如何把握导向、新时代青年如何从百年党史中汲取力量等进行了提问，杨浩东以通俗的语言、生动的事例一一解答，他殷殷寄语青年党员，要从党的百年奋斗史中，汲取奋进的力量，紧密团结在党中央周围，坚定不移跟党走,用青春奉献书写责任和担当。

chosen.text: During the interactive session, representatives from grassroots cadres, enterprises, and young people asked about the relationship between the three historical resolutions, how to understand the decisive significance of "two establishments," how cultural enterprises should grasp the orientation, and how contemporary youth can draw strength from the century-old party history. Yang Haodong answered each question with simple language and vivid examples. He earnestly encouraged young party members to draw strength for progress from the century-long struggle history of the party, to closely unite around the Central Committee of the Party, to be unwavering in following the Party's lead, and to write responsibility and commitment through their youth.

src: 2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人-新华网

chosen.text: The expected number of university graduates in Beijing region in 2022 is around 268,000 - Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Xinhua reporter Yang Na) From the recent video conference jointly held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau to discuss 2022 college graduate employment and entrepreneurship work, it was learned that the expected number of graduates from Beijing's universities this year is around 268,000, an increase of 16,000 compared to last year.

src: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。

chosen.text: A relevant official from the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau stated that employment work for graduates from Beijing universities would be deployed through measures such as strengthening supply-demand matching, reinforcing policy support, broadening job-seeking channels, ensuring assistance to those in difficulty, supporting entrepreneurship and innovation, and improving service efficiency.

src: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批 ” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。

chosen.text: The Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau is building practice platforms to increase job supply, actively contacting 40 university graduate workplace experience bases, visiting employers, and integrating demand and job information; focusing on "six batches," which include expanding recruitment for public institutions, expanding recruitment for state-owned enterprises, expanding recruitment for grassroots projects, expanding enlistment for the military, expanding placement of internships to retain graduates, and expanding entrepreneurship to drive employment; implementing "one-to-one" dynamic management, recommending no less than five job information options to each graduate, ensuring that all graduates from difficult families with employment aspirations are fully supported.

src: 民主峰会落幕，拜登称自由之火永不熄灭

chosen.text: The Democracy Summit concludes, and Biden says the flame of freedom will never be extinguished.

src: 由美国总统拜登召集、有全球110个国家的政府以及公民社会和私营部门领导人出席的线上“民主峰会 ” ( Summit for Democracy)星期五（12月10日）落幕。

chosen.text: The online "Summit for Democracy," convened by US President Biden and attended by government leaders from 110 countries, civil society representatives, and private sector leaders, concluded on Friday (December 10).

src: 拜登在闭幕词中说，自由之火在世界每个人的心中燃烧，专制政权永远无法将其熄灭。

chosen.text: Biden said in his closing remarks that the flame of freedom burns in the hearts of people around the world, and authoritarian regimes can never extinguish it.

src: 他也表示，计划明年召开第二届全球“民主峰会 ” 。

chosen.text: He also said that he plans to hold a second Global 'Democracy Summit' next year.

src: 台湾政府代表、政务委员唐凤和目前流亡英国的香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪也在第二天的峰会上发言。

chosen.text: Taiwan’s government representative and Information Minister Teng Fong, as well as Lo Guanhong, a pro-democracy and human-rights activist currently in exile in the UK, also spoke at the summit on the second day.

src: 拜登说 ： “ 我们知道摆在我们面前的工作是多么的艰巨。

chosen.text: Biden said: "We know how daunting the work before us is."

src: 但我们也知道，我们可以迎接挑战，因为我以前说过，正如这次峰会所表明的，民主世界无处不在。

chosen.text: But we also know that we can meet the challenge, as I have said before, just as this summit shows, democracy is everywhere.

src: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧 。 ”

chosen.text: Authoritarian regimes can never put out the flicker of freedom that burns in the hearts of people all around the world and everywhere.

src: 拜登还表示，捍卫民主需要整个社会的共同努力。

chosen.text: Biden also stated that defending democracy requires the concerted effort of society as a whole.

src: 他说 ： “ 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人 。 ”

chosen.text: He said, "As leaders of the government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, fortify the bulwark of democracy, push for reforms, achieve transparent accountability governance, be better able to resist the buffer and shock of authoritarianism, and those who want to pursue power nakedly before public interest."

src: “民主峰会”第二天的主题分别是捍卫人权，巩固民主与对抗威权，以及反击数字威权主义与肯定民主价值。

chosen.text: The second day of the "Democracy Summit" focuses on defending human rights, consolidating democracy, countering authoritarianism, and countering digital authoritarianism while reaffirming democratic values.

src: 这一天恰逢“国际人权日 ” 。

chosen.text: It fell on International Human Rights Day.

src: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在当天的开场讲话中也表示，民主事业在全球面临挑战，特别是新兴数字技术带来的挑战。

chosen.text: UN Secretary-General António Guterres also noted in his opening remarks that the cause of democracy faces challenges globally, particularly from emerging digital technologies.

src: 他说 ： “ 现在是重申共同价值观和立场以及民主韧性的时候了。

chosen.text: He said: "It is now time to reaffirm our shared values and positions, as well as the resilience of democracy."

src: 这需要深化社会对话，解决不平等问题，打击腐败，更新社会契约，为优质教育投资，并扩大妇女和女童的机会。

chosen.text: This requires deepening societal dialogue, addressing inequality, fighting corruption, updating social contracts, investing in quality education, and expanding opportunities for women and girls.

src: 这也需要坚决谴责一切形式的民粹主义、本土主义和极端主义，包括利用技术革命所提供的所有工具 。 ”

chosen.text: This also requires firm condemnation of all forms of populism, nationalism, and extremism, including all tools provided by the technological revolution. ”

src: 香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪通过预先录制的视频对峰会发表讲话，提醒与会者持续关注香港和维吾尔族和藏族等中国少数民族的人权状况。

chosen.text: Hong Kong democracy and human rights activist Lo Guolong delivered his remarks via a pre-recorded video at the summit, reminding participants to continue paying attention to human rights conditions in Hong Kong and among China’s minorities, such as the Uighurs and Tibetans.

src: 他说 ： “ 长期以来，世界一直接受中国的崛起，却没有建立一个机制来对其进行问责。

chosen.text: He said: "For a long time, the world has accepted China's rise without establishing a mechanism to hold it accountable."

chosen.text: We must use everything we have (resources) to ensure that the revival of democracy is our top priority.”

chosen.text: He said: "Perhaps some of you are afraid of angering General Secretary Xi Jinping, perhaps some of you do not want to lose the Chinese market, or perhaps some of you have not recognized (the Communist Party's) threat to our democratic values."

src: 台湾行政院政务委员唐凤在出席“打击数字独裁主义，肯定民主价值”的圆桌讨论中，通过视频发布《国家声明 》 ， 强调台湾站在对抗专制和威权的最前线。

chosen.text: Taiwan’s Minister of Administration Deputy Chen Fenggong, attending a roundtable discussion titled "Fighting Digital Authoritarianism and Affirming Democratic Values," released the “State Statement” via video, emphasizing Taiwan’s stance at the forefront in combating autocracy and authoritarianism.

src: 他也分享了如何通过信息透明与构建互信来抗击新冠疫情的经验。

chosen.text: He also shared his experience of fighting the pandemic through information transparency and building mutual trust.

src: 他说 ： “ 在台湾的民主方兴未艾之际，我们始终坚定站在全球对抗威权主义的最前线，更在促进全球自由、民主和人权上，扮演领导角色。

chosen.text: He said that, while democracy in Taiwan is on the rise, we have always stood resolutely at the forefront of global efforts to counter authoritarianism, and we have also played a leading role in promoting global freedom, democracy, and human rights.

src: 于疫情期间，各地的威权政府以公共卫生和集体利益为名，合理化侵犯人权的行为，全球民主呈现倒退的迹象。

chosen.text: During the pandemic, authoritarian governments in various places justified human rights violations under the guise of public health and collective interest, indicating a retreat of global democracy.

src: 然而在台湾，我们不必封城就能控制疫情，不必下架就能战胜假信息 。 ”

chosen.text: However, in Taiwan, we can control the pandemic without citywide lockdowns and defeat misinformation without removing it from shelves.

src: 就在“民主峰会”第二天日程进行的同时，美国财政部宣布对被认定严重侵犯人权的中国、朝鲜等几个国家的15名个人、10个实体依法实施制裁，同时对一家被认定利用监视技术协助侵犯人权的中国公司实施投资限制。

chosen.text: Wan teachers for rural primary schools in Jiangxi will be trained within three years – Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师各１名，共计１万名。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Nanchang, May 22 (Xinhua reporter Chen Yushan) Recently, the Jiujiang Provincial Education Department has informed that to enhance the capacity of teachers in key disciplines and achieve balanced development of primary education in rural areas, starting from 2016, Jiangxi plans to train 1,000 qualified music, art, and physical education teachers over three years for every primary school in the province's rural areas (townships and below).

src: 据了解，这次培训对象为江西全省乡村小学４５岁以下具有音乐、美术、体育学科知识基础或才能，能兼任音乐、美术、体育课程的其他学科教师。

chosen.text: It is understood that the target of this training includes other subject teachers in primary schools across rural areas of Jiangxi province who are under the age of 45 and have a foundational knowledge or talent in music, art, and physical education subjects, allowing them to teach these subjects alongside their main subjects.

src: 通过培训，使他们掌握音体美学科教学的基本知识和教学技能，更新教学思想和观念，掌握现代教学方法，提高学科教学能力、活动设计能力、校园文化能力及自我发展能力，建设一支一专多能的音体美教师队伍，缓解乡村音体美教师缺乏的问题。

chosen.text: Through training, they will acquire basic knowledge and teaching skills for subjects like music, physical education, and art, update their teaching ideas and concepts, master modern teaching methods, enhance their subject teaching abilities, activity design capabilities, campus culture abilities, and self-development capabilities, build a team of multi-skilled music, physical education, and art teachers, and alleviate the shortage of such teachers in rural areas.

src: 为确保培训质量和效果，江西还规划为全省１００个县（市、区）小学音乐、美术、体育各培训１名，共计３００名培训者，全面提升他们的教学示范引领能力、教研活动设计组织能力、施训能力、网络研修工作坊建设能力，起到教授、示范、指导、监督的作用。

chosen.text: To ensure quality and effectiveness of training, Jiangxi also plans to train one music, art, and physical education teacher in each of the province's 100 counties (cities, districts), totaling 300 trainers. These trainers will enhance their teaching demonstration and leading abilities, curriculum research activity design and organization skills, training capabilities, and network seminar workshop construction skills, serving as instructors, models, guides, and supervisors.

src: 前段时间有篇《快看！项目经理可冲击金牌的奥运项目》文章很火，里面提到项目经理们在很多项目上，绝对是可以一马当先，无人能匹： 搬砖、出差、熬夜是项目经理的日常，救火、背锅、道歉更是不在话下。

chosen.text: Recently, there was an article titled "Check this out! The Olympic Projects that Project Managers Can Reach Gold Medals For," which mentioned that project managers can absolutely lead in many projects without any competition: Moving bricks, traveling for work, and staying up late are part of the daily routine for project managers, while putting out fires, taking the blame, and apologizing are all common occurrences.

src: 看似玩笑调侃的一篇文章，却也道出了项目经理们的日常辛酸，背后代表的是对当前项目管理工作的力不从心。

chosen.text: A seemingly light-hearted article reveals the daily hardships of project managers, and behind it lies a sense of inadequacy towards current project management work.

src: 而从事项目管理工作的人员，也渐渐选择通过一些行动来让自己摆脱工作中的困境。

chosen.text: And personnel engaged in project management are also increasingly choosing actions to extricate themselves from the difficulties of their work.

src: 从每年攀升的PMP（国际认证的项目管理专业人士资格）报名人数来看，越来越多的项目管理从业人员通过学习来提升自己的项目管理能力。

chosen.text: With the increasing number of applicants for the PMP (Project Management Professional, an internationally recognized project management certification), more and more project management professionals are enhancing their project management capabilities through learning.

src: 据《中国项目管理二十年发展报告(1999-2019)》称：截止到2019年9月，全国累计PMP®报考人数近60万人次，通过PMP®认证人数约42万人，有效持证人数约30万人, 占全球PMP®持证总量的31.2%。

chosen.text: According to the "China's Twenty-Year Development Report on Project Management (1999-2019)", as of September 2019, the cumulative number of people who have taken the PMP® exam nationwide approached 600,000, with approximately 4.2 million people having obtained PMP® certification, and around 3 million people holding valid certificates, accounting for about 31.2% of the global pool of PMP® holders.

src: 近10年PMP持证人数逐年递增，这说明越来越多的项目管理者意识到：靠简单照搬以往“老经验”来做事已不可取，瞬息万变的工作环境让我们知道一个要学会，站在科学巨人的肩膀上去探索前行的道路。

chosen.text: Over the past decade, the number of PMP holders has grown annually, indicating that project managers are increasingly aware that relying solely on past "old experience" to do things is no longer viable. The rapidly changing work environment teaches us that we must learn to explore and move forward by standing on the shoulders of scientific giants.

src: 然而，考了PMP就能保证项目管理工作畅通无阻了吗？

chosen.text: However, passing the PMP exam guarantees smooth sailing in project management work?

src: 很多项目管理初学者表示，通过学习PMP/IPMP等相关课程，可以系统性地掌握项目管理的十大领域和五大过程组等相关知识点，但真正进行项目管理工作的时候却还是一头雾水。

chosen.text: Many project management beginners state that by learning courses related to PMP/IPMP, they can systematically grasp the ten domains and five process groups of project management along with related knowledge points; however, when actually engaging in project management work, they still feel lost.

src: 很多项目经理常常反馈以下问题： 项目管理认知不到位，单纯依靠个人经验，空有项目管理理论，不知如何实践； 缺乏系统的项目管理流程制度支撑，工作中无法落地，项目预估不准，把控度灵敏度差，项目一拖再拖； 成员分工不明确、团队中的“老油条”不知如何应对 跨部门协助沟通不顺畅，项目难以推进 ……

chosen.text: Many project managers often report the following issues: inadequate project management knowledge relying solely on personal experience, hollowed-out with project management theories, unable to put them into practice; lack of systematic project management processes and procedures, making it difficult to implement these processes in work, inaccurate project estimation, low responsiveness, and projects dragging on for too long; unclear member roles and responsibilities, baffled by how to deal with "seasoned veterans" within the team, poor cross-departmental collaboration leading to inefficient communication, making it hard to push the project forward…

src: 因此，专注产品创新与研发管理领域十余载，已帮助众多优秀的企业培养了大批的产品经理、项目经理等研发关键人才，并获得了 “中国企业研发管理人才培训示范基地”等荣誉称号的中天华夏咨询带着《研发项目经理特训营》线上课程来了。

chosen.text: Having focused on product innovation and research and development management for over a decade, we have helped numerous excellent enterprises cultivate a large number of product managers, project managers, and other key R&D talent, earning honors such as “Base for Training High-Quality Talent in China’s Enterprises for Research and Development Management.” With this in mind, Zhongtian Hexia Consulting brings you the Online Training Camp for Product Project Managers.

src: 《研发项目经理特训营》线上课程 这是一种线上碎片化学习的方式，结合了众多研发型企业的实战案例、工具和方法，帮助您掌握项目经理必备知识及标准动作，走上自身项目管理的进阶之路。

chosen.text: "Project Manager Training Camp" Online Course This is an online, fragmented learning approach that combines practical cases, tools, and methods from various R&D-oriented enterprises to help you master the essential knowledge and standardized steps for a project manager, leading you on the path to advancing your own project management skills.

src: 这也是一次让企业用更低的成本和更少的投入，促进项目经理的培养进程，为企业带来高效运作结果的机会。

chosen.text: This is also an opportunity for enterprises to promote the development of project managers at lower costs and with fewer resources, leading to efficient operations for the company.

src: 口说无凭，可以先看看其他学员怎么评价这门课程： 这门课程不仅是由中天华夏专家团队（原华为研发管理团队），结合国际先进的项目管理方法论和众多知名企业真实业务场景，对课程内容进行深入浅出的专业讲解。

chosen.text: Without a written record, you could first see how other students evaluate this course: Not only is it taught by an expert team from Zhong Tian Huaxia (originally Huawei's R&D management team), which integrates advanced project management methodologies from around the world with numerous real business scenarios of leading enterprises, but also provides in-depth and accessible professional explanations for its content.

src: 更是会提供科学实用的管理工具与方法，丰富的模板表单，帮助学员在课后将学习的内容转化运用于具体工作。

chosen.text: According to the Consumer Finance Literacy Survey Analysis Report released this year by the People's Bank of China, the national consumer finance literacy index is 66.81, up 2.04 from 2019.

src: 总体上，我国居民在金融消费层面上的表现较好，但在金融行为和技能的不同方面体现出较大的差异性，还需要进一步提升基础金融知识水平。

chosen.text: Overall, Chinese residents perform well in financial consumption, but exhibit significant differences in various aspects of financial behavior and skills, and need to further improve their foundational knowledge of finance.

src: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低 ， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。

chosen.text: The level of financial literacy among the elderly and adolescents is relatively low, and the elderly and young people will continue to be the focus of ongoing attention in financial education; the Young China Youth Liability Report published by Nielsen and the Young China Youth Consumption Report 2019-2020 published by Central Finance showed that the young generation has a huge consumption potential, and credit consumption has become an important way of increasing consumption. 86.6% of young people are using credit products, almost half of whom have no debt accumulation.

src: 作为持牌消费金融机构，捷信一直致力于以优质、贴心的服务助力百姓构建自己的幸福生活，倡导消费者树立良好正确的消费观，并积极响应监管号召，以实际行动提升消费者尤其是年轻群体的理性消费意识。

chosen.text: As a licensed consumer finance institution, JiXin has been dedicated to providing high-quality, considerate services to help citizens build their own happy lives. It promotes consumers to establish good and correct consumption concepts and actively responds to regulatory calls to raise rational consumption awareness among consumers, especially young groups, through practical actions.

src: 在过去多年间，捷信不断针对包含大学生在内的青年群体开展全方位、多样化的金融知识普及活动，并通过与国内顶级院校合作发动创新实践大赛等多种形式潜移默化对年轻群体的消费需求进行合理引导,帮助其树立理性消费观念,合理规划消费需求,进而为其累积人生财富助力。

chosen.text: Over the past several years, Credence has conducted comprehensive and diverse financial literacy campaigns targeting young groups such as college students, and has guided their consumption demands in a reasonable manner through various forms, including innovation practice competitions with top domestic universities, to help them establish rational consumption concepts, plan their needs reasonably, and assist them in accumulating wealth for their lives.

src: 双十二到来之际，捷信提醒所有消费者朋友树立合理的消费意识和正确的金钱观，抵制盲目消费和过度消费，规避消费借贷误区，以免影响个人征信以及今后的经济生活。

chosen.text: Ahead of Double Twelve, Zhixin reminds all consumers to develop reasonable consumption awareness and a proper perspective on money, resist blind and excessive spending, avoid misconceptions about consumption loans, and prevent it from affecting personal credit as well as future economic life.

src: 消费时一定要提前规划，量力而为按时还款。

chosen.text: One must plan ahead and stay within one's means when spending and make timely repayments.

src: 如果逾期，逾期记录将记录到个人信用报告中，可能会对日后买车、购房等经济生活造成不良影响。

chosen.text: If it is overdue, a late payment record will be added to your personal credit report, which may have negative impacts on future economic activities such as buying a car or a house.

src: 与此同时，在享受金融产品和服务时，还应选择正规机构及渠道，并注意查验相关机构是否具备经营资质。

chosen.text: Meanwhile, when enjoying financial products and services, one should choose legitimate institutions and channels and verify whether the relevant institutions have the necessary operating licenses.

src: 未来，捷信将一如既往凭借其成熟、可靠的消费金融体系和不断更新迭代的金融产品，为消费者带来更贴合需求和多元化的服务，不断助力大众提升金融知识水平，帮助消费者培养理性消费、适度借贷的理念，做消费者终生可信赖的消费金融伙伴。

src: 让大学精神与时代精神同频共振-新华网

chosen.text: Syncing the University Spirit with the Spirit of the Age - Xinhua News Agency

src: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。

chosen.text: The spirit of a university refers to a set of educational philosophies and value pursuits that have been long-accumulated over the course of its development, constituting the soul of the university.

src: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。

chosen.text: Throughout history, the spirit of the university has been crucial for the development of politics, economy, culture, science and technology, society, and even a nation's progress.

src: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。

chosen.text: From the birth of the first modern university as we know it, universities have borne a unique mission distinct from other organizations. For our universities, which emerged during a time of national peril, this spirit has been deeply influenced by traditional culture and the evolution of times. They advocate values such as "morality for the benefit of the world, rectification of self and peace throughout the state," and the patriotic duty of "promoting learning to strengthen the nation."

src: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧 ” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。

chosen.text: Currently, there is an increasingly evident trend of informatization and internationalization in higher education, with intensified global competition in education, science and technology, and talent. As an important "supply-side" sector, the structural reform of higher education is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges.

src: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。

chosen.text: The especially the proposal of the “Overall Plan for the Comprehensive Promotion of World-Class University and Disciplinary Construction,” which not only demonstrates China’s confidence and determination to move from a major country in higher education to a strong country in higher education, but also sets higher and more updated requirements for university development.

src: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车 ” ？

chosen.text: How can we quickly strive to enter the ranks of world-class players while still having some distance to cover, and accelerate the construction of several world-class universities and a number of world-class disciplines, in order to achieve “leapfrogging” development?

src: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。

chosen.text: Besides being confident in their goals, path, and capabilities, universities should also leverage three key strengths: first, the advantage of being a latecomer, through continuous recruitment of distinguished overseas academic talents and learning from the best practices of world-class universities to significantly enhance academic standards and institutional quality; second, cultural advantage, by inheriting the wisdom embedded in five millennia of Chinese civilization and promoting and developing excellent traditional culture in order to rally forces, brand themselves, and elevate their image; and third, institutional advantage, by tapping into the superior institutional advantages of a socialist country, driving toward objectives, consolidating shared consensus, optimizing resource allocation, and providing a robust sustainable foundation for the schools to accelerate catching up with world-leading standards.

src: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。

chosen.text: It is particularly important to realize that building world-class universities cannot be one-size-fits-all, and each school must highlight its own strengths while showcasing its unique character and characteristics.

src: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。

chosen.text: The characteristics of education must have both commonalities with Chinese characteristics and reflect their unique goals, institutional traditions, and resource endowments.

src: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。

chosen.text: For Zhejiang University, we focus on three distinctive features in our operations: first, emphasizing the cultivation of entrepreneurial and innovative talent, building an integrated education environment that combines education and science and technology with industry and enterprises to form a complete entrepreneurial education ecosystem; second, emphasizing the convergence of disciplines, driving the optimization and adjustment of the disciplinary system, fostering an institutional environment for interdisciplinary work, and actively nurturing emerging interdisciplinary disciplines and landmark interdisciplinary achievements; third, focusing on the educational system and social service features, deepening international cooperation, and accelerating the formation of a broader partnership network for research, education, and innovation around Zhejiang University.

src: 在这个过程中，尤为重要的是，要始终坚守大学精神，让大学精神与时代精神同频共振。

chosen.text: During this process, it is especially important to uphold university spirit and ensure that it resonates with the spirit of the times.

src: 对于浙江大学来说 ， “ 求是创新”校训 ， “ 勤学、修德、明辨、笃实”共同价值观以及“海纳江河、启真厚德、开物前民、树我邦国”共同构成了浙大精神的最新表述体系。

chosen.text: For Zhejiang University, the motto "Innovation for the Quest for Truth," the shared values of "study diligently, cultivate morality, discern clearly, and practice earnestly," along with the shared spirit encapsulated in "Encompassing rivers and seas, enlightening truth, nurturing virtue, and benefiting the people, building our nation," constitute the latest expression system of Zhejiang University's spirit.

src: 这是学校坚持正确办学方向，不断积累文化高度、凝聚精神力量的重要保障，内涵丰富，意义深远。

chosen.text: This is an essential safeguard for the school to uphold its correct educational mission and continuously accumulate cultural heights and spiritual strength; it is rich in content and of profound significance.

src: 其中 ， “ 海纳江河”强调的是开放包容精神，体现以“天下英才为我所用”的胸怀，表现为汲取世界名校办学育人的优质理念 ； “ 启真厚德”强调的是求真至善精神，指的是大学在追求真理的同时，更当领受德行的陶冶和人格的砥砺 ； “ 开物前民”体现的是改革创新精神，既包含知识的求新，科研的创新，又表现为改革发展，革故鼎新 ； “ 树我邦国”强调的是爱国奉献精神，讲的是大学应当始终与民族命运同荣共辱。

chosen.text: Among them, "Oceanic and Riverine" stresses an open and inclusive spirit, reflecting a mindset of harnessing the talents of the world, manifested in absorbing the best educational philosophies from world-renowned institutions; "Awakening Truth and Cultivating Virtue" emphasizes a spirit of seeking truth and goodness, which means that universities should not only pursue truth but also be nourished by moral cultivation and shaped by personal development; "Opening Up the World and Benefiting the People" embodies a spirit of innovation and reform, encompassing both the pursuit of new knowledge and innovative research, as well as reform and renewal; "Raising Our Homeland" stresses a patriotic dedication spirit, which means that universities should always stand shoulder to shoulder with the fate of the nation.

src: 这一系列精神理念和价值追求，正是浙江大学120年办学的灵魂所在。

chosen.text: These set of spiritual principles and value pursuits is precisely what has been at the soul of Zhejiang University’s 120 years of establishment.

src: “聪者听于无声，明者见于未形 ” 。

chosen.text: "Smart ears hear without sound, wise eyes see before things take shape."

src: 中国高校当进一步立足中国特色社会主义事业全局，深刻把握高等教育事业所处的时代方位和肩负的历史使命，加快建设成为世界一流大学。

chosen.text: China’s universities should further position themselves within the broader context of socialism with Chinese characteristics, deeply understanding their era’s place and historical mission in the higher education sector, and accelerate efforts to build world-class universities.

src: 同时，坚守人文关怀和独立自由，让大学精神与时代精神、民族精神互相激荡，从而为实现国家富强和民族振兴，实现人类的共同理想提供不竭的动力。

chosen.text: At the same time, upholding humanistic care and independent freedom allows university spirit to resonate with the spirit of the times and the national spirit, thus providing inexhaustible motivation for achieving national prosperity and the rejuvenation of the nation, as well as realizing humanity’s common ideals.

src: 新华社北京12月11日电 12月11日，国家主席习近平向2021年大湾区科学论坛致贺信。

chosen.text: Xinhua Beijing, December 11 – President Xi Jinping of the People's Republic of China sent a message of congratulations to the 2021 Greater Bay Area Science Forum on December 11.

src: 习近平指出，当今世界正经历百年未有之大变局，全球科技创新进入密集活跃期，新一轮科技革命和产业变革对全球经济结构产生了深刻影响。

chosen.text: Xi pointed out that the world is currently undergoing a major transformation of historic proportions, with global science and technology innovation entering a period of high activity, and new rounds of technological revolution and industrial transformation having a profound impact on the global economic structure.

src: 粤港澳大湾区要围绕建设国际科技创新中心战略定位，努力建设全球科技创新高地，推动新兴产业发展。

chosen.text: The Greater Bay Area of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao should focus on its strategic positioning as an international center for innovation and technology, work to build a global hub for innovation, and drive the development of emerging industries.

src: 中国愿同世界各国科学家、国际科技组织一道，密切国际科技交流合作，加强重大科学问题研究，促进共性科学技术破解，深化重点科学项目协作，共同推进世界科学事业发展，更好造福人类。

chosen.text: China is willing to work with scientists from all over the world and international scientific organizations to enhance international cooperation and exchanges in science and technology, strengthen research on major scientific issues, promote breakthroughs in common technologies, deepen collaboration on key scientific projects, and jointly advance the development of global scientific progress for the greater benefit of mankind.

src: 2021年大湾区科学论坛当日在广东省广州市开幕，主题为“探索未来，共享科学 ” ， 由广东省人民政府主办。

chosen.text: The 2021 Greater Bay Area Science Forum opened on Monday in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, with the theme of "Exploring the Future, Sharing Science," and was hosted by the Government of Guangdong Province.

src: 广西大学生休学创业年限最长可达５年-新华网

chosen.text: The maximum duration of suspension for college students in Guangxi to start their own businesses is up to 5 years - Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社南宁５月１９日专电（记者张莺）记者近日从广西壮族自治区教育厅获悉，今后广西各高校将实施弹性学制，放宽大学生休学年限，在校生休学创业的年限在原有学制基础上可延长２至５年，休学创业时间可视为实践教育时间。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Nanning, May 19, 2023 (Reporter Zhang Ying) – Recently, from the Education Department of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, it was learned that in the future, universities across Guangxi will implement flexible academic systems, relaxing the duration of students' leaves of absence. The period for students to leave school to start their own businesses can be extended by 2 to 5 years beyond the original curriculum duration, and the time spent on entrepreneurship can be regarded as practical education time.

src: 为促进大学生创业创新能力提升，广西教育、人社等部门合力搭建创业平台，建设更多大学生校外实践教学基地、大学科技园、大学生创业园、创业孵化基地等，给大学生创业提供外在保障。

chosen.text: To promote the enhancement of college students’ entrepreneurial innovation capabilities, relevant departments such as education and human resources in Guangxi have cooperated to build entrepreneurship platforms, establishing more off-campus practice teaching bases for college students, university technology parks, college student startup zones, and entrepreneurship incubators, thereby providing external guarantees for college students’ entrepreneurship.

src: 根据要求，到２０２０年，各高校创新创业实践基地面积，本科学校要达到３０００平方米以上，高职学校要达到２０００平方米以上。

chosen.text: According to the requirements, by 2020, the area of the entrepreneurship and innovation practice bases for universities should be above 3,000 square meters for undergraduate schools, and above 2,000 square meters for vocational colleges.

src: 政府鼓励高校设立创新创业学分，优先支持在创新创业实践中表现优异的学生转专业。

chosen.text: The government encourages universities to establish entrepreneurial and innovative credit points and prioritizes supporting students who excel in their entrepreneurial and innovative practices to switch majors.

src: 高校教师每两年要至少有两个月到行业企业挂职锻炼，以此提高教师创新创业教育的意识和能力。

chosen.text: College teachers should spend at least two months in industry enterprises each two years to enhance their awareness and ability in teacher entrepreneurship and innovation education.

src: 自治区教育厅要求广西各高校深入实施大学生创新创业训练计划，力争使每一名大学生在校期间都参与一项创新创业训练计划。

chosen.text: The Education Department of the Autonomous Region requires universities in Guangxi to implement the College Students Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program in depth, aiming for each college student to participate in at least one innovation and entrepreneurship training program during their time at school.

src: 高校要积极组织学生参加各级各类创新创业竞赛，并给予经费支持。

chosen.text: Colleges and universities should actively organize students to participate in various levels of innovation and entrepreneurship competitions and provide funding support.

src: NEWS GOV-MO: 澳大向7位杰出人士颁授荣誉博士学位

chosen.text: NEWS GOV-MO: Australia Honors Seven Outstanding Individuals with Doctor of Laws Degrees

src: 澳门大学今（11）日举行“2021年荣誉学位及高等学位颁授典礼 ＂ ， 向刘遵义、陈凯先、中村修二、李兰娟、李效良、朱丽兰及江朝晖颁授澳大荣誉博士学位，以表彰其卓越成就、为社会和教育的发展所作出的重大贡献。

chosen.text: The University of Macau held today an “Honorary Doctorates and Higher Degrees Conferral Ceremony 2021,” conferring Honorary Doctorates from the University of Macau to Liu Zhenyu, Chen Kaixian, Hiroshi Nakamura, Li Lanjuan, Li Xialiang, Zhu Liran, and Jiang Chaohui in recognition of their outstanding achievements and significant contributions to society and education.

src: 颁授典礼上，行政长官兼澳大校监代表、社会文化司司长欧阳瑜在澳大校董会主席林金城、澳大校长宋永华陪同下颁授荣誉博士学位。

chosen.text: At the conferral ceremony, on behalf of the Chief Executive and the Chair of the Board of Governors of the University, Secretary for Social and Cultural Affairs Ouyang Yu conferred the Doctor of Honor degree at the University with the assistance of Chairman Lin Jincheng of the University’s Board of Governors and President Song Yonghua of the University.

src: 刘遵义教授获颁荣誉教育博士学位、陈凯先教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、中村修二教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李兰娟教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李效良教授获颁荣誉工商管理博士学位、朱丽兰教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位，江朝晖女士获颁荣誉理学博士学位。

chosen.text: Professor Liu Zhenyu was awarded an honorary Doctor of Education degree, Professor Chen Kaixian was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science degree, Dr. Nakamura Hiroshi was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science degree, Professor Li Lanjuan was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science degree, Professor Li Xiaoliang was awarded an honorary Doctor of Business Administration degree, Professor Zhu Lilan was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science degree, and Ms. Jiang Chaohui was awarded an honorary Doctor of Science degree.

src: 欧阳瑜致辞时首先向获颁发荣誉博士学位的七位杰出人士，表示热烈的祝贺并致以崇高的敬意，他们分别在不同的领域取得非凡的成就，为国家的发展和世界的进步作出了卓越的贡献；同时，欧阳瑜向毕业生和家长表达最真挚的祝福，也向大学爱岗敬业、学术精湛的教职员团队致以由衷的敬意。

chosen.text: During his address, Ouyang Yu expressed warm congratulations and high respect to the seven distinguished individuals who were awarded Honorary Doctorates for their remarkable achievements across various fields, which have made outstanding contributions to the development of the country and the advancement of the world; he also conveyed his most heartfelt blessings to the graduates and parents, and paid sincere respects to the dedicated and scholarly faculty team of the university.

src: 澳大人文学院讲座教授孙艺风宣读刘遵义赞辞时表示，刘遵义教授是一位享誉全球的经济学家，以其卓越的学术成就和前瞻性的教育理念而闻名。

chosen.text: Professor Sun Yifeng, who read Professor Liu Zhongyu’s eulogy at the Australian National University, noted that Professor Liu is a globally renowned economist known for his outstanding academic achievements and forward-thinking educational philosophy.

src: 除了在经济发展、经济增长及东亚经济领域取得的成就外，他还是一位富有远见的教育领导者。

chosen.text: In addition to his achievements in economic development, economic growth, and East Asia economics, he is also a visionary education leader.

src: 简而言之，他在众多领域都有杰出建树。

chosen.text: In essence, he has made notable contributions in numerous fields.

src: 孙艺风宣读中村修二赞辞时表示，中村修二教授是可持续能源技术的先驱者。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read out Professor Nakamura Shuji's eulogy, stating that Professor Nakamura is a pioneer of sustainable energy technology.

src: 他因发明蓝色发光二极管（LED）而成为2014年诺贝尔物理学奖的三位获奖者之一。

chosen.text: He became one of the three winners of the 2014 Nobel Prize in Physics for inventing the blue light-emitting diode (LED).

src: 中村教授的发明不仅彻底改变了照明行业，更推动产生了如今广泛应用于日常生活和工业生产的白色发光二极管，为人类的福祉做出了巨大的贡献。

chosen.text: Professor Nakamura's invention not only revolutionized the lighting industry but also gave rise to today's widespread white light-emitting diodes (LEDs) used in daily life and industrial production, making significant contributions to human welfare.

src: 孙艺风宣读李兰娟赞辞时表示，李兰娟教授作为中国人工肝事业的开拓者，创建独特有效的李氏人工肝系统，治疗重型肝炎肝衰竭获重大突破，显著降低肝衰竭的病死率。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read out the eulogy for Li Lanjuan, expressing that Professor Li was an pioneer of China's artificial liver program and established a unique and effective Li’s artificial liver system, achieving major breakthroughs in treating severe hepatitis and hepatic failure, significantly reducing the mortality rate of hepatic failure.

src: 在这次新冠肺炎抗击战中，她和团队所提出的“四抗二平衡”方案及带去的人工肝、微生态和干细胞三大技术，显著提高了重症救治率。

chosen.text: In the fight against COVID-19, her team's proposed "Four Antevers and Two Balances" solution, along with the technologies of artificial liver, microbiome, and stem cells they brought, significantly improved the mortality rate for severe cases.

src: 孙艺风宣读李效良赞辞时表示，李效良教授为运营管理的创新研究奠定了基础，塑造了供应链理论和实践的思维方式，并彻底改变了世界各地的商业模式。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read out the eulogy for Professor Li Xialiang, stating that Professor Li laid the foundation for innovative research in operations management, shaped the thinking behind supply chain theory and practice, and fundamentally transformed business models worldwide.

src: 李效良因普及运筹管理中的长鞭效应概念而闻名，并探索了应对这种现象的措施。

chosen.text: Li Xiaoliang is known for popularizing the concept of the Bullwhip Effect in supply chain management and exploring measures to address this phenomenon.

src: 如今，各国在疫情及紧张的经济局势下，长鞭效应愈发突显，引发供应链严重破坏。

chosen.text: Now, with the pandemic and economic tensions, the stick effect is becoming more pronounced, leading to severe disruptions in supply chains.

src: 李效良具有远见的研究如雪中送炭，帮助行业应对困境，从而带来巨大的社会价值。

chosen.text: Li Xialiang's visionary research serves as a ray of hope, helping the industry to navigate through tough times and bring about significant social value.

src: 孙艺风宣读朱丽兰赞辞时表示，在科研工作中，她发现了一种突破性和创新的染色技术用于制备样品，在国内外科技同行中享有较高声誉。

chosen.text: Sun Yifeng read out the eulogy for Zhu Liang, stating that in her research work, she discovered a breakthrough and innovative staining technique used to prepare samples, which enjoys high reputation among domestic and international scientific peers.

src: 她以非凡的科技成就荣膺国际欧亚科学院院士等重要荣誉称号，以自己辉煌的业绩为自己在世界科技圣殿赢得了应有的崇高地位。

chosen.text: She was awarded important honorary titles such as Fellow of the International Academy of European Sciences for her remarkable technological achievements, thus securing her rightful lofty status in the temple of world science.

src: 澳大中华医药研究院代院长陈新宣读陈凯先赞辞时表示，陈凯先教授从事药物研发40余载，杰出的科学成就以及对国家、澳门、澳门大学、国家重点实验室的重要贡献使其拥有崇高的国际地位和声望。

chosen.text: Dr. Chen Xin, on behalf of the Executive President of the Australian Chinese Medicine Research Institute, read out Professor Chen KaiXian's tribute, stating that Professor Chen has made distinguished scientific achievements throughout more than four decades in drug research and development, and his significant contributions to the country, Macao, the University of Macao, and National Key Laboratories have earned him a high international standing and reputation.

src: 他对澳门和大湾区中医药事业发展的积极推动作用充分体现了其为国家医药发展战略奉献的使命感。

chosen.text: His proactive role in promoting the development of traditional Chinese medicine in Macau and the Greater Bay Area fully embodies his sense of mission to contribute to the country's pharmaceutical strategy.

src: 澳大科技学院院长须成忠宣读江朝晖赞辞时表示，江朝晖女士参与研发的重大发明和专利，至今累积超过15项与存储虚拟化、导航、文件系统和电源管理相关，无不实用性高，使用广泛，提升人类生活便利度。

chosen.text: President of Macao Science and Technology College Cai Chengzhong read the tribute for Jiang Chaohui, stating that the significant inventions and patents developed by Ms. Jiang have accumulated over 15 items related to storage virtualization, navigation, file systems, and power management, all of which are highly practical, widely used, and enhance human convenience in daily life.

src: 作为卓有成就的发明家，江女士往往能把高深的科技和理论化繁为简，普及大众。

chosen.text: As an accomplished inventor, Ms. Jiang is often able to simplify complex technology and theories in a way that makes them accessible to the general public.

src: 最后，陈凯先作为荣誉博士代表宣读谢辞。

chosen.text: Lastly, Chen KaiXian read the farewell remarks on behalf of the honorary doctoral representatives.

src: 他很高兴看到澳门及大湾区的医药事业树立了一个良好的典范：从澳大建立的第一个中药质量研究国家重点实验室到大湾区中医药的蓬勃发展，澳大在整合大湾区中医药领域优秀人才中贡献了巨大作用。

chosen.text: He was pleased to see that pharmaceuticals in Macao and the Greater Bay Area have set a good example: from the first National Key Laboratory of Traditional Chinese Medicine Quality Research established at the University of Macau to the thriving development of TCM in the Greater Bay Area, the University of Macau has made significant contributions in integrating top talents in the TCM field across the Greater Bay Area.

chosen.text: Strategy lies in finding direction, and tactics lie in implementation. There is room for strategic thinking above most tactical considerations.

src: 比如如何增加顾客数（战术思维）之上，可以思考是在当前领域持续深化还是横向领域延展（战略思维）；比如提升顾客留存率（战术思维）之上，可以思考如何提升核心顾客和高价值顾客的留存率（战略思维）；在提升活动参与度（战术思维）之上，可以考虑如何设置正确的活动KPI，达到正确的活动目标，比如提升目标顾客参与度、激活高价值沉默客、精准拉新；在提升DAU（战术思维）之上，可以考虑目前的增长是否健康可持续。

chosen.text: For instance, instead of focusing on increasing customer numbers (tactical thinking), one can think about either deepening within the current domain or expanding horizontally to adjacent domains (strategic thinking); for example, instead of improving customer retention rates (tactical thinking), one can focus on boosting the retention rates of core customers and high-value customers (strategic thinking); atop enhancing activity participation rates (tactical thinking), one can consider how to set correct KPIs for activities, achieving the right goals such as boosting target customer participation, activating high-value dormant customers, and targeting new users accurately; atop boosting DAU (tactical thinking), one can assess whether current growth is healthy and sustainable.

src: 新华社华盛顿５月２３日电（记者徐剑梅）美国１３０多个亚裔团体２３日向美国教育部和司法部提交申诉，抗议３所常春藤名校 — — 耶鲁大学、布朗大学和达特茅斯学院在招生过程中歧视亚裔申请学生。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Washington, May 23 (Xu Jianmei) – On May 23, more than 130 Asian-American groups submitted an appeal to the U.S. Department of Education and the Justice Department protesting against the discrimination against Asian-American applicants in the admissions process of three Ivy League universities – Yale University, Brown University, and Dartmouth College.

src: 牵头发起申诉的亚裔教育联盟当天在华盛顿召开新闻发布会。

chosen.text: The Asian American Education Coalition, which spearheaded the appeal, held a news conference in Washington that day.

src: 该团体主席赵宇空在发布会上说，过去１０年里，符合美国名校录取条件的亚裔申请人数量成倍增长，但在这３所美国名校中，亚裔所占比例基本维持在同一水平。

chosen.text: Chairman Zhao Yuke stated at the press conference that over the past ten years, the number of Asian applicants meeting the requirements for admission to top American universities has grown exponentially; however, in these three prestigious American universities, the proportion of Asians remained largely at the same level.

src: 许多研究表明，这些高校在所谓“综合考量”的招生过程中 ， “ 长期持续性以及系统化地歧视亚裔申请学生 ” 。

chosen.text: Many studies show that these colleges engage in what is euphemistically referred to as "holistic review," systematically and persistently discriminating against Asian American applicants.

src: 赵宇空介绍说，２０１４年桑德斯等学者的研究显示，在这３所高校里，相对申请者人数，亚裔在所有族裔中录取率最低。

chosen.text: Zhaoyukong explains that in 2014, scholars such as Sanders showed that among these three universities, Asians had the lowest acceptance rate relative to the number of applicants among all ethnic groups.

src: 美国教育部的数据也显示，在所有常春藤盟校中，布朗大学和达特茅斯学院对亚裔学生的录取比例最低，耶鲁大学和布朗大学对亚裔申请学生实施了事实上的种族配额达２０年以上。

chosen.text: Data from the US Department of Education also shows that among all Ivy League schools, Brown University and Dartmouth College have the lowest acceptance rates for Asian students, and Yale University and Brown University have implemented de facto racial quotas for Asian applicants for over 20 years.

src: 赵宇空告诉新华社记者，他们期望提交申诉后，美国教育部、司法部能够展开调查，并在认定事实后采取措施阻止这些高校继续在招生中歧视亚裔。

chosen.text: Zha Yukuang told a reporter with Xinhua that they expect the US Department of Education and Justice to launch an investigation after their appeal is submitted, and take action to prevent these universities from continuing to discriminate against Asians in admissions once facts are determined.

src: 他们也期望被投诉高校能够主动重视这一问题，改变对亚裔的招生政策。

chosen.text: They also expect complaint universities to actively take this issue seriously and change their admissions policies towards Asians.

src: 目前，被投诉的３所高校尚未作出回应。

src: 亚裔教育联盟成立于２０１５年，当时曾投诉哈佛大学招生歧视，但美国教育部以程序理由未予受理。

chosen.text: The Asian American Education Alliance was founded in 2015, when it had filed a complaint against Harvard University's admissions for discrimination, but the U.S. Department of Education declined to accept the case on procedural grounds.

src: 2020年9月，陆先生从房屋中介了解到一处位于浙江余姚丈亭镇的厂房，在多次现场看房后，陆先生决定购买该厂房。

chosen.text: In September 2020, Mr. Lu learned about a factory located in Zhongting Town, Yuyao, Zhejiang Province, from a real estate agent. After multiple site visits, Mr. Lu decided to purchase the factory.

src: 同年12月，陆先生就购买厂房的细节与房屋所有权人的家属林某进行磋商后，于当天通过银行转账汇款20万元作定金。

chosen.text: In December of the same year, Mr. Lu had discussions with Mrs. Lin, the family of the property owner, regarding the details of buying the factory, and transferred 200,000 yuan as a deposit via bank transfer that same day.

src: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”

chosen.text: Lin signed as the recipient on the earnest money receipt for the factory sale, which states, "If the buyer does not want to buy this factory, the earnest money will go to the seller. If the seller is unwilling to sell this factory, the earnest money will be doubled and returned to the seller. The parties have agreed that the factory sales contract will be signed within one week."

src: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。

chosen.text: However, they were unable to reach an agreement on the main contract terms such as the scope of the factory sale and the payment method, which delayed the signing of the house purchase contract.

src: 考虑到双方未能就合同内容达成共识，几天后，林某将20万元定金退回给了陆先生。

chosen.text: Considering that both parties had failed to reach consensus on the contract terms, Liu returned the 200,000 yuan deposit to Mr. Lu a few days later.

src: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。

chosen.text: The house he had finally set his sights on, the deposit was already paid and the down payment was also ready, they just needed to sign the contract when the seller suddenly decided not to sell anymore. This made Mr. Lu both frustrated and angry.

src: 为此，陆先生将林某起诉至余姚市人民法院。

chosen.text: Therefore, Mr. Lu filed a lawsuit against Lin in Yuyao People's Court.

src: 法院经审理认为，双方最终未能签订正式合同，不能仅归责于被告，应合理推定为磋商不成，故本案不应适用定金罚则，被告无需承担双倍返还定金的违约责任。

chosen.text: The court, after reviewing the case, found that the parties ultimately failed to enter into a formal contract and this cannot solely be attributed to the defendant. It should reasonably be presumed that negotiations did not succeed, hence this case should not apply the penalty for a breach of the earnest money deposit. Therefore, the defendant is not required to bear the liability of double repayment of the earnest money deposit.

src: 一审判决后，原告提起上诉。

chosen.text: After the first-instance judgment, the plaintiff appealed.

src: 近日，二审法院维持原判。

chosen.text: Recently, the appellate court upheld the original judgment.

src: 【律师提醒】 在交易过程中要尽到必要的审慎注意义务。

chosen.text: Lawyers advise to exercise necessary due diligence during the transaction process.

src: 在签订合同时，作为买方要尽到必要的审慎注意义务，比如，核实房屋所有权人信息、房屋是否被人占用等相关信息，并在合同中明确关于交付的具体时间、地点，以防履行合同时双方产生争议。

chosen.text: At the time of signing the contract, as the buyer, one must exercise necessary due diligence, such as verifying information about the property owner, whether the house is occupied, and stipulating in the contract the specific timing and location for delivery to avoid disputes during performance.

src: （德国之声中文网 ） " 民主峰会"周五结束后，中国外交部发言人周六（12月11日）发表谈话表示，美国举办"领导人民主峰会 " ， 是"以意识形态划线，把民主工具化、武器化，假民主之名行反民主之实，煽动分裂对抗，转移国内矛盾 " 。

chosen.text: After the "Summit for Democracy" ended on Friday, China's Foreign Ministry spokesman made a statement on Saturday (December 11th) expressing that the US hosting the "Summit for Democracy" was "to draw ideological lines, to instrumentalize and militarize democratic tools under the guise of democracy, to carry out anti-democratic practices in the name of democracy, and to stir up division and confrontation while diverting domestic contradictions."

src: 中国政府认为 ， " 长期以来，美国将自己的政治制度和价值理念强加于人，推行'民主改造 ' ， 滥施单边制裁，策动'颜色革命 ' ， 造成灾难性后果。

chosen.text: The Chinese government views that “for a long time, the US has imposed its political system and values on others, promoting 'democracy transformation', abusing unilateral sanctions, and instigating 'color revolutions', with catastrophic consequences.”

src: '民主'早已成为美国干涉别国的'大规模杀伤性武器 ' 。

chosen.text: 'Democracy' has already become America's 'weapon of mass destruction' in interfering with other countries.

chosen.text: The two-day meeting was conducted via video, with leaders from 111 countries invited to attend, including Taiwan's leader, but China and Russia were not invited.

chosen.text: Ahead of the summit, China and Russia criticized the US for its own democratic issues, saying the US did not have the right to host such a summit.

src: 而国际上和美国国内也有质疑声音，例如批评受邀与会的包括一些有威权专制倾向的领导人，比如菲律宾、波兰和巴西等国的领导人，有人怀疑拜登政府的真正意图并非为了民主而是为了地缘政治目的组织了这次峰会。

chosen.text: And there are also doubts internationally and within the United States, such as criticism of leaders with authoritarian tendencies, including some heads of state from countries like the Philippines, Poland, and Brazil, being invited to attend. Some doubt that the Biden administration’s true intention was not to promote democracy but to organize the summit for geostrategic purposes.

chosen.text: The statement from the Chinese Foreign Ministry on Saturday noted, "Today's American democratic malaise is clearly evident: issues such as money politics, identity politics, party polarization, political extremism, social fragmentation, racial tensions, and wealth disparity continue to escalate," stating that American democracy is a "game for the rich" based on capital.

src: 美国总统拜登在发言中表示 ， " 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人 。 "

chosen.text: U.S. President Biden said in his remarks, “As leaders of the government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, fortify the bulwarks of democracy, push for reforms, achieve transparent accountability governance, be better able to resist the buffers and shocks of authoritarianism, and those who seek naked power before public interest.”

src: 他强调，民主并不是想当然的 ， " 我们必须在每一代人当中不断更新它，在我看来，这是我们这个时代的决定性挑战 。 "

chosen.text: He emphasizes that democracy is not an entitlement, “We must keep refreshing it from generation to generation, in my view, this is the decisive challenge of our time.”

chosen.text: The US pledged to launch a year-long initiative following the Democracy Summit, which includes a $424.4 million initiative aimed at strengthening democracies worldwide and supporting independent media outlets.
