chosen.text: On this note, it deserves praise for these three students who directly wrote to express themselves.

src: 其实，上过大学的人都清楚，突击备考、想各种办法从老师处“套取”考题，争取划考试范围，求得考前得到“重点辅导”的现象并不少见，甚至在考试中夹带小抄、考后求老师高抬贵手的情况也不是奇闻。

chosen.text: In fact, college graduates know that cramming for exams, trying various methods to “extract” exam questions from teachers, seeking to narrow the scope of the exam, and begging for prior “key tutoring” is not uncommon during exams, even to the point where students might resort to cheating with crib notes or seek leniency from teachers after the exam.

src: 在笔者看来，作为一种教学质量评估导向，衡量一所大学考试的合格与否，更在于教师对教与学的全面把握，以及在此基础上的科学命题。

chosen.text: In my view, as a guide for evaluating the quality of education, judging whether a university’s exams are qualified hinges on teachers’ comprehensive grasp of teaching and learning, along with scientific question-setting based on this.

src: 进入大学本科阶段，专业开始细分，很多专业课程以基础知识为主。

chosen.text: Entering university undergraduate programs, disciplines begin to specialize, with many courses focusing on foundational knowledge.

src: 毋庸置疑，是否全面掌握一个学科的基本知识点，是大学考试要考察的内容。

chosen.text: There is no doubt that having a solid grasp of the fundamental knowledge of a discipline is what university exams assess.

src: 而本科知识基本都是学科基础理论和基本常识，从知识点而言，变化的空间并不大，基本是固定的。

chosen.text: While undergraduate knowledge is largely based on foundational theories and basic common sense within disciplines, from a knowledge point of view, there is not much room for change; it is essentially fixed.

src: 就像有教师所言 ， “ 20年前学大学数学的基本知识，现在还在学，还是重点 。 ”

chosen.text: Just as a teacher might say, "Basic knowledge of university mathematics that was learned 20 years ago is still being studied and remains a focus."

src: 但知识点基本不变，并不代表考试题型单一、试题重复。

chosen.text: But the basic knowledge points remain unchanged, does not mean that the exam format is monotonous or that the questions are repetitive.

src: 在很多大学，考试一般都会组成出题组，再由学科资深教师统筹组成试卷，考试阅卷也由承担该科的全体老师参与，这样就能在一定程度上克服试题重复的情况。

chosen.text: In many universities, exam questions are typically compiled by a committee, which is then overseen by senior faculty members in the relevant discipline. Exam grading is also conducted by all teachers assigned to that subject, which helps to mitigate the issue of repetitive questions to some extent.

src: 但要拟出一套符合教与学实际的试题，题目根据学生学习整体情况，难易呈正态分布，还需综合掌握教学情况，全面分析学生学习的程度，从而使考试命题对难易、题型有动态把握，既能突出基础知识考察，又能兼顾能力考查，同时对题型进行创新设计。

chosen.text: But to devise test questions that align with actual teaching and learning, with difficulty levels distributed normally according to students' overall learning situation, one needs to have a comprehensive grasp of the teaching situation and conduct a thorough analysis of students' learning levels. This will enable exam question formulation to have dynamic control over difficulty and question type, allowing for both the emphasis on basic knowledge assessment and the consideration of ability evaluation, while also innovating in the design of question types.

src: 考试是大学教育的指挥棒，有什么样的考试，学生就会有相应的备考方案，长此以往，将影响大学教育的成效。

chosen.text: Exams are the guiding rod for university education; with what kind of exams there are, students will adopt corresponding preparation plans. In the long run, this can affect the effectiveness of university education.

src: 对于学生的建议信，兰州交大校方高度重视，已在全校部署了整改的方案。

chosen.text: The recommendation letters for students have been highly prioritized by the administration of Lanzhou Jiaotong University, which has already implemented a plan for rectification across the campus.

src: 要求各教学单位组织教师开展研讨和课程结课考试对照自查，制定考试试卷命题及相关制度，同时加强对考试试卷命题及审核环节的监督与检查，细化成绩评定，加强课程教学各环节的全面考核。

chosen.text: Require teaching units to organize teachers in conducting seminars and self-inspections of course exams and final exams, formulate examination paper questions and related systems, and strengthen supervision and inspection of the examination paper formulation and review process. Detail the evaluation of grades, and comprehensively evaluate each stage of the course teaching.

src: 从机制上解决试题类型单一、题目重复等问题是大学考务需要面对的议题，当然需要出台相应的制度，但功夫贵在日常，需要教师对教学情况的全面掌握，不单要吃透教学内容，更须吃透学生学习情况，两头吃透，教与学将更好对接，形成良性互动，考试也将更加符合实际，从而让“学霸”和“学渣”各得其所。

chosen.text: Addressing the issue of monotonous question types and repetitive questions, which stem from a single examination format, is a topic that university examinations must confront. While implementing appropriate policies is necessary, the effort lies in daily practice. This requires teachers to have a comprehensive understanding of teaching conditions, not just mastering the curriculum content but also fully grasping the students' learning situations. By covering both ends, teaching will better align with learning, fostering a more positive interaction, and examinations will be more aligned with reality, thus allowing "top students" and "underperformers" to find their rightful place.

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11, 12th, Commentator Article from People's Daily: A Good Start for the "14th Five-Year Plan" – An Analysis of Learning and Implementing the Spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference

src: “实现了‘十四五’良好开局 ” ， 12月8日至10日举行的中央经济工作会议高度评价一年来我国经济社会发展取得的成绩。

chosen.text: "Realized a good start to the '14th Five-Year Plan', " the central economic work conference held from December 8 to 10 highly evaluated the achievements made in the country's socio-economic development over the past year.

src: 习近平总书记在会上发表重要讲话，深刻总结2021年经济工作，深入分析当前经济形势，对2022年经济工作作出重大部署，为我们做好明年经济工作，迎接党的二十大胜利召开，指明了前进方向、提供了根本遵循。

chosen.text: Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the meeting, summarizing in depth the economic work of 2021, deeply analyzing the current economic situation, and making major arrangements for 2022 economic work. His remarks pointed the way forward and provided fundamental guidance for us to do our economic work next year and to welcome the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

src: 我们隆重庆祝中国共产党成立一百周年，正式宣布全面建成小康社会、实现第一个百年奋斗目标，开启全面建设社会主义现代化国家、向第二个百年奋斗目标进军新征程。

chosen.text: We celebrate with great enthusiasm the centenary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, officially declaring the comprehensive building of a moderately prosperous society and the accomplishment of the first centenary goal, and embarking on a new journey to comprehensively build a modern socialist country and advance toward the second centenary goal.

src: 我们召开党的十九届六中全会，总结党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验，通过百年党史上第三个历史决议《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议 》 ， 这是新时代中国共产党人牢记初心使命、坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的政治宣言，是以史为鉴、开创未来、实现中华民族伟大复兴的行动指南。

chosen.text: We convened the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee to summarize major achievements and historical experiences of the Party’s century-long struggle, passing the third historical resolution in the Party’s history, “Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party’s Century-Long Struggle.” This is a political declaration by contemporary Chinese Communists to remember their original aspiration and founding mission and to uphold and develop socialism with Chinese characteristics, and it is also a guide for action to draw lessons from history, forge ahead, and realize the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 一年来，世界百年未有之大变局和新冠肺炎疫情全球大流行交织影响，外部环境更趋复杂严峻，国内新冠肺炎疫情防控和经济社会发展各项任务极为繁重艰巨。

chosen.text: In the past year, the complex and severe external environment has been influenced by the interweaving of the century-level changes in the world and the global pandemic of COVID-19, with domestic tasks of COVID-19 prevention and control as well as economic and social development being extremely heavy and arduous.

src: 以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚持统筹国内国际两个大局，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，沉着应对百年变局和世纪疫情，统筹疫情防控和经济社会发展，加快构建新发展格局，强化宏观政策跨周期调节，着力促进经济持续健康发展，着力深化改革开放创新，奋力完成改革发展艰巨任务，党和国家各项事业取得了新的重大成就。

chosen.text: Under the leadership of the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the central leadership has been coordinating domestic and international situations, adhering to a work tone of steady progress amid improvement, and calmly responding to both the century-scale changes and the global pandemic. It has been balancing epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development, accelerating the construction of a new development pattern, strengthening macro-policy cross-cycle regulation, focusing on promoting sustained and healthy economic development, deepening reform and innovation, and striving to complete arduous tasks in reform and development. As a result, major achievements have been made in all fields of Party and state endeavors.

src: “十四五”实现良好开局，一个重要方面体现在，构建新发展格局迈出新步伐，高质量发展取得新成效。

chosen.text: A good start has been achieved during the "14th Five-Year Plan" period, with an important aspect being the new strides taken in establishing a new development pattern, and new achievements made in high-quality development.

src: 我国经济发展和疫情防控保持全球领先地位，发展韧性强、潜力大、动力足的特点持续显现；国家战略科技力量加快壮大，重大创新成果竞相涌现，科技创新能力持续提升，关键核心技术攻关实现新突破；产业链韧性得到提升，对外贸易量增质升，结构继续优化，以新产业新业态新模式为代表的新动能成长壮大；改革开放向纵深推进，着力打通制约供需适配和要素流动的堵点，以高水平对外开放打造合作竞争新优势；民生保障有力有效，就业规模持续扩大，居民收入增长与经济增长基本同步，全年粮食连续7年保持在1.3万亿斤以上，喜获“十八连丰 ” ； 生态文明建设持续推进，碳达峰碳中和工作统筹推进，绿色低碳转型步伐稳健，生态环境保护取得新成效。

chosen.text: China has maintained global leadership in economic development and epidemic prevention and control, showcasing characteristics of strong resilience, great potential, and ample momentum. Strategic scientific and technological power is growing stronger, with a steady stream of major innovative achievements, continuous improvements in its innovation capabilities, and breakthroughs made in key technology research and development. The strength of its industrial chain has been enhanced, foreign trade volumes have increased while quality has improved, the structure continues to be optimized, and new drivers of growth such as new industries, new business models, and new forms of employment continue to grow and expand. Deepening reforms and opening-up is advancing further, efforts are being made to clear up bottlenecks that hinder supply-demand alignment and the flow of factors, and China is creating new advantages through high-level opening-up. Robust measures have been taken for social protection, employment scales continue to expand, residents’ incomes have grown in tandem with GDP growth, annual grain output has consistently remained above 1.3 trillion catties over the past seven years, bringing about another “eighteen consecutive bountiful harvests”; Ecological civilization construction is ongoing, work on achieving peak carbon and net-zero emissions is advancing in an integrated manner, progress is being made in green and low-carbon transitions, and new

src: 这些成绩的取得，是以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导的结果，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引的结果，是全党全国各族人民勠力同心、艰苦奋斗的结果。

chosen.text: These achievements are the result of the strong leadership of the Communist Party of China under Comrade Xi Jinping, the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and the joint efforts of the entire party, the country, and all ethnic groups.

src: 实践再次证明，党确立习近平同志党中央的核心、全党的核心地位，确立习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的指导地位，对新时代党和国家事业发展、对推进中华民族伟大复兴历史进程具有决定性意义。

chosen.text: Practice has proven once again that the Party's establishment of Comrade Xi Jinping as the core of the Central Committee and the whole Party, and the establishment of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the guiding ideology, possess decisive significance for the development of the cause of the Party and the country in the new era, and for advancing the historical process of national rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 有习近平总书记作为党中央的核心、全党的核心领航掌舵，有习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引，有全党全国各族人民团结一心、顽强奋斗，我们就一定能够战胜各种艰难险阻，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家新征程上创造新的时代辉煌、铸就新的历史伟业。

This will allow us to create new glories of our times and achieve new great endeavors in history.

src: 让我们更加紧密地团结在以习近平同志为核心的党中央周围，增强“四个意识 ” 、 坚定“四个自信 ” 、 做到“两个维护 ” ， 不断提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，以实际行动把党中央决策部署落实到位，不断把新时代中国特色社会主义事业推向前进。

src: 教育资讯：北京压缩2016年初中入学特长生比例-新华网

chosen.text: Education News: Beijing Reduces Proportion of Special Talent Admissions for Middle School Entrance in 2016 - Xinhua Net

src: 21日、22日两日，北京市初中入学特长生考查工作由各区教委统一组织实施。

chosen.text: On the two days of January 21st and 22nd, the Beijing Municipal Education Commission organized and implemented the examination for talented students in junior high school admissions through each district's education commission.

src: 今年，北京各区均压缩了特长生招生比例，特长生竞争更为激烈。

chosen.text: This year, the enrollment ratio of specialized students has been reduced in every district in Beijing, making competition for these students more intense.

src: 以东城区为例，今年该区小学升初中特长生入学比例总体不超过全区招生计划数的5 % ， 计划招生人数为380人，到校比例不超过学校招生计划数的10 % 。

chosen.text: For example, in Dongcheng District, this year the overall percentage of elementary school students admitted to junior high schools through special talent programs does not exceed 5% of the district's enrollment plan, with an enrollment plan of 380 students; the admission rate to schools does not exceed 10% of the school’s enrollment plan.

src: 凡具有体育、艺术、科技特长且在网上报名的学生均有资格参加特长生招生考查。

chosen.text: All students who have a special education in sports, arts and technology and are enrolled online are eligible to take the special education entrance exam.

src: 为方便学生就近参加考查，东城区延续去年的考查安排方式，在每个学区分别设置1~2个考查地点，共13个考查地点。

chosen.text: To facilitate students in attending inspections conveniently nearby, Dongcheng District will continue the inspection arrangement from last year, setting 1-2 inspection sites in each study zone, totaling 13 inspection sites.

src: 考点均按考区划分考场，以小时为单位划分时段，考查当天学生将按时段进入考点在不同考区考场内进行考查。

chosen.text: The examination will be conducted within the different examination districts on the day of the examination.

src: 5月23日，区教育招生考试中心网上公示考查通过的学生名单，学生可在网上查询考查结果。

chosen.text: On May 23, the list of students who passed the examination was publicly displayed on the district education and recruitment examination center's website, and students could check their examination results online.

chosen.text: Chairman of the Bosnian Olympic Committee: Believes China has the capability to host the Winter Olympics successfully during special times - Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社萨拉热窝12月11日电 波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇近日表示，波方十分期待北京冬奥会，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会。

chosen.text: Xinhua Salajevo, December 11 – Chairman of the Bosnian Olympic Committee Kvesic recently stated that the Bosnian side is very much looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympics and firmly believes China has the capability to host this Winter Sports Festival in a special period.

src: 日前中国驻波黑大使季平在萨拉热窝奥林匹克中心会见波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇。

chosen.text: Recently, Chinese Ambassador to Bosnia and Herzegovina Qi Ping met with BiH Olympic Committee President Kvesic at the Sarajevo Olympic Center.

src: 会见时，克韦西奇积极评价波中关系并表示，他曾于2008年北京夏奥会之际访华，对中方出色的组织工作印象极为深刻，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会；波方十分期待北京冬奥会，波黑奥委会正在积极组织参会；波方希望以此为契机，同中方在体育领域开展更为广泛的交流合作。

chosen.text: During the meeting, Kvesic positively assessed the Sino-Bosnian relationship and stated that he had visited China during the Beijing Summer Olympics in 2008, where he was deeply impressed by the excellent organizing work of the Chinese side, and believed that China has the capability to host the Winter Games successfully in exceptional circumstances. The Bosnian side is very excited about the Beijing Winter Olympics, and the Bosnian Olympic Committee is actively organizing participation. They hope to use this opportunity to further broaden their cooperation and exchanges in sports with China.

src: 季平表示，中波两国有着特殊的“奥运纽带 ” 。

chosen.text: Qianping noted that there is a special "Olympic bond" between the two countries.

src: 1984年萨拉热窝冬奥会在这里成功举办，再过两个月，2022年北京冬奥会也将拉开帷幕，将向世界呈现一场简约、安全、精彩的盛会。

src: 48小时核酸阴性、设“缓冲区 ” 国务院联防联控机制发文要求加强口岸城市疫情防控-新华网

chosen.text: 48 Hours of Nuclear Acid Negative, Buffer Zone Establishment of the Joint State Council Joint Defense Control Mechanism to Strengthen Coastal City Epidemic Control - Xinhua Network

src: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者董瑞丰、顾天成）国务院联防联控机制日前印发关于加强口岸城市新冠肺炎疫情防控工作的通知，要求近期离开陆地边境口岸城市（与香港、澳门有口岸相连的除外）人员需持有48小时内核酸检测阴性证明，前往陆地边境口岸城市人员抵达后至少进行1次核酸检测。

chosen.text: Xinhua Beijing, December 11 (Ding Ruofeng and Gu Tiancheng) -- The State Council Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism recently issued an instruction on strengthening COVID-19 prevention and control in border cities. It requires that people who recently left land-border port cities (excluding those connected to Hong Kong and Macau) need to present a negative nucleic acid test within 48 hours, while those who travel to border port cities should undergo at least one nucleic acid test upon arrival.

src: 根据通知，上述要求的时间范围为，从各省区市确定口岸城市范围并公告之日起，至2022年3月15日。

chosen.text: According to the notification, the time frame for the above requirements is from the day on which the provincial regions and municipalities determine the scope of border cities and announce it, until March 15, 2022.

src: 此外，通知还提出，有条件的口岸城市可研究在辖区内设置疫情防控缓冲区。

chosen.text: Furthermore, the notice also proposes that cities with ports of entry may study establishing buffer zones for epidemic prevention and control within their jurisdictions.

src: 国家卫生健康委疾病预防控制局有关负责人介绍，对于一些口岸城市来说，跨境边贸是当地主要经济支柱，双方边民往来频繁。

chosen.text: A relevant official from the National Health Commission's Department of Disease Prevention and Control introduced that for some border cities, cross-border border trade is a major economic pillar, with frequent interactions between both sides' residents.

src: 实行分区差异化管理政策，由一道防控外溢防线变为两道防线，有望实现关口前移，压缩疫情外溢风险，以最小社会影响、最低社会成本实现疫情防控最大成效。

chosen.text: Implementing differentiated management policies for different areas transforms one barrier to contain external spread into two barriers, potentially shifting the focus of control towards earlier stages and compressing the risk of regional transmission. This approach aims to achieve the greatest public health outcome with the least social impact and cost in epidemic control.

src: 近期我国发生多起本土聚集性疫情，均是境外疫情经口岸城市输入。

chosen.text: Recently, multiple local cluster outbreaks in China have occurred, all of which are due to imported cases from border cities abroad.

src: 上述通知指出，这暴露出一些地方疫情监测预警不及时、高风险岗位人员闭环管理不落实、定期核酸检测流于形式、冷链物品各环节消杀不到位、集中隔离场所管理不规范、疫情应急处置不够科学精准等问题。

chosen.text: The announcement noted that this exposed problems such as inadequate early warning of local surveillance of epidemics, non-implementation of close-loop management of high-risk positions, regular detection of nucleic acid flows into the form, non-destruction of cold chain items, non-regulation of the management of concentrated quarantine facilities, insufficient scientific accuracy of emergency management of epidemics, etc.

src: 通知要求，从完善口岸城市疫情防控机制、健全疫情监测预警体系、落实边境管控措施等9个方面着力，加快补齐口岸城市防控短板弱项，毫不放松、科学精准做好防控工作，织密扎牢外防输入防线。

chosen.text: The notice requires focusing on nine aspects, including improving epidemic prevention mechanisms in border cities, strengthening pandemic monitoring and early warning systems, and implementing border control measures, to accelerate the rectification of weaknesses and shortcomings in port city defenses. It calls for unwavering, precise, and scientific efforts in prevention and control work to tighten and reinforce the defense against external input.

src: 通知强调，各口岸城市要将疫情防控与民生保障工作同步研究、同步部署，公布并畅通民生保障热线，定期排查基本生活物资供应、价格等方面的苗头隐患，及时解决和主动回应群众反映的突出问题。

chosen.text: The notice emphasizes that port cities should concurrently study and deploy measures for epidemic prevention and control with their work on ensuring public welfare, and should publish and ensure smooth flow of hotline services for public welfare. They should periodically identify early signs of issues related to the supply and price of basic living necessities, and promptly address and actively respond to public concerns about prominent problems.

src: 根据通知，其中所指的口岸城市包括开放的陆路、水路、航空口岸所在县（市、区、旗 ） 、 所在市（地、州、盟）及所在直辖市，具体范围由各省（自治区、直辖市）根据疫情防控需要确定并及时公告。

chosen.text: According to the notification, the port cities referred to include counties (cities, districts, or banners) and the cities (regions, prefectures, or leagues) where open land, water, and air ports are located, as well as their respective direct-controlled municipalities. The specific scope will be determined based on epidemic prevention needs by each provincial (autonomous region, municipality directly under the central government) and announced in a timely manner.

src: 逛书市时，往往能感受到成功学类书籍的火爆。

chosen.text: When browsing through book markets, one often feels the popularity of self-help books.

src: 现今的成功学书籍，很多宣扬的都是“最好原则 ” — —即先假定或暗示你能“做到 ” ， 然后再告诉你需要做到的事情“是什么 ” 。

chosen.text: The current self-help books often promote the "best-case principle" – that is, assuming or implying that you can "do it," and then telling you what you need to do.

src: 等于说一下子越过了“如何做到”这个其实最重要、最根本的环节。

chosen.text: It means skipping over the most important and fundamental step of “how to do it.”

src: 正因如此，这些书都有一个共同的特点 — — 要么就一鼓作气地干到最好，要么就干脆什么也别干；要么就是100，要么就是0；要么你就登泰山，要么你就干脆在原地待着。

chosen.text: That is why all these books have one common characteristic – either go all out and do your best, or just don’t do anything at all; either 100% or nothing; either climb Mount Tai, or just stay put.

src: 这种“最好原则 ” ， 让谁看都会承认“正确无比 ” ， 但是99%的人都会被吓倒在起跑线前。

chosen.text: This "best principle," which everyone will acknowledge as "perfect" upon seeing it, would nonetheless leave 99% of people flat on their faces at the starting line.

src: 因为这种理论鼓吹的是一种“你要痛下决心，重新做人，来个180度的大转变”的路径，而这恰恰是很多人的致命弱项。

chosen.text: Because this theory promotes a path of “you need to make a firm decision and start anew, with a 180-degree turnaround,” which is precisely what many people’s biggest weakness is.

src: 对于墨守成规、因循守旧、拒绝变化的人，你偏偏要在他的耳旁大喊“你要转变 ” ， 无疑是自欺欺人、对牛弹琴之举。

chosen.text: For those who are conservative, resistant to change, and unwilling to adapt, shouting at them from their ear, "You need to change," is nothing but self-deception and hitting a cow with a piano.

src: 绝大多数人都会在“转变”两字面前露怯，裹足不前，难下决心；又或者凭着一时的冲动痛下了“转变”之决心，并勇敢地迈出了第一步，但往往是好景不长，坚持不了多一会儿就败下阵来，难见持续性。

chosen.text: Most people would falter at the word “transformation,” hesitating and lacking resolve; or they might make a hasty decision to embark on “transformation” out of impulse, bravely taking the first step, but it is often short-lived, as persistence does not last long, and they fail to sustain it for any considerable time.

src: 马三立先生那段著名的《从明天开始》的相声，就是最传神地表现了这一“普遍人性”的经典。

chosen.text: Mr. Ma's renowned comedic sketch "From Tomorrow Onward" is the quintessential example of this "common humanity".

src: “最好原则”的最大问题在于门槛太高，它往往超越了普通人的能力极限，让绝大多数人“望门兴叹 ” 。

chosen.text: The biggest problem with the "Best Principle" is that it has a too high threshold, often exceeding the capability limits of ordinary people, leaving most to be "speechless in front of a grand entrance."

src: 或许 ， “ 次好原则”才是一种有可能让更多普通人走上相对成功之路的途径。

chosen.text: Perhaps, “second-best principle,” could be a route that allows many ordinary people to achieve relative success.

src: “次好原则”的核心在于“降低门槛 ” — —它鼓励的是一种“积小胜为大胜”的理论，即如果做不到100，只做到1也行：因为1永远大于0；如果登不上泰山，只登上你家门口的小沙丘也行，因为那也总比原地踏步强。

chosen.text: The core of the "Principle of Sufficiency" lies in "lowering the threshold"—it promotes a theory of "winning small battles to win big ones," which means that doing 1 is acceptable even if 100 cannot be achieved; for 1 is always greater than 0; and if one cannot reach Mount Tai, climbing to your front-yard dune is better than standing still.

src: 总之，只要你做了点什么，就总比不做强。

chosen.text: In any case, doing something is always better than doing nothing.

src: 由于门槛大幅度降低，因此就多了使普通人做到坚持的可能性，而凡事只要坚持，成功概率也会加大。

chosen.text: With the threshold significantly lowered, there is more possibility for ordinary people to persevere, and the probability of success will also increase as long as one persists.

src: 只不过遵循“次好原则”的成功之路，其路程略长一些而已。

chosen.text: Following the "second-best" principle still leads to success, albeit on a longer path.

src: 总而言之 ， “ 最好原则”尽管在表面上打着让所有人都成功的旗号，但它最终能够激励的，实际上还是少数；而“次好原则 ” ， 才能有效激励更多的人，尽可能地让更多人受益。

chosen.text: In essence, while the "best-fit principle" may tout success for everyone on the surface, it ultimately motivates only a few; in contrast, the "second-best principle" effectively motivates more people and aims to benefit as many as possible.

src: 青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年增加0.71万吨-新华网

chosen.text: The resource stock of Qinghai Lake huchen increased by 0.71 million tons this year - Xinhua.

src: 新华社西宁12月11日电（记者骆晓飞、张宏祥）记者从青海省农业农村厅获悉，最新监测结果显示，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年较上年增加0.71万吨,达到10.85万吨，与2002年保护初期相比，累计增长40余倍。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Xining, Dec. 11 (Xu Xiaofei and Zhang Hongxiang)—The latest monitoring results show that the natural resources of naked carp in Lake Qinghai have increased by 0.71 million tons this year compared to last year, reaching a total of 10.85 million tons. Compared with the initial period of protection in 2002, the cumulative growth has exceeded forty times.

src: 青海湖裸鲤俗名“湟鱼 ” ， 是青海湖中特有的珍贵鱼种，对维系青海湖流域“水-鱼-鸟”生态链安全和生物多样性有着举足轻重的作用。

chosen.text: Arctic Grayling, also known as "Huang Yin" in Qinghai Lake, is a unique and precious fish species endemic to Qinghai Lake. It plays a crucial role in maintaining the ecological safety of the "water-fish-bird" chain in the lake and preserving biological diversity in the Qinghai Lake Basin.

src: 20世纪六七十年代，受人为大量捕杀、裸鲤繁殖水域环境日益退化等因素影响，青海湖裸鲤数量锐减，2002年青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量仅为2592吨。

chosen.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, due to excessive hunting by humans and deteriorating environmental conditions for the breeding of scaleless carp in Qinghai Lake, the population of scaleless carp in Qinghai Lake sharply declined. By 2002, the estimated biomass of scaleless carp resources in Qinghai Lake was only 2,592 tons.

src: 2004年在《中国物种红色名录》中青海湖裸鲤被列为濒危物种。

chosen.text: In the Red List of Chinese Species in 2004, the Qinghai Lake Barbel was listed as an endangered species.

src: 从2003年起，青海省实施封湖育鱼，禁止任何单位、集体和个人到青海湖及湖区主要河流及支流捕捞裸鲤，禁止销售裸鲤及其制品。

chosen.text: Since 2003, Qinghai Province has implemented a lake closure to breed fish, prohibiting any units, collectives, or individuals from fishing for huchen in Qinghai Lake and its main rivers and tributaries, as well as the sale of huchen and its products.

src: 与此同时，通过人工增殖放流以及清理青海湖主要入湖河流河道、设计科学合理的“过鱼通道”等措施持续加大保护力度，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量逐年增加。

chosen.text: At the same time, by continuing to increase protection efforts through measures such as artificial seedstock release and cleaning of major rivers entering Qinghai Lake, as well as designing scientifically reasonable “fish passage facilities,” the stock of Qinghai Lake huchen has been increasing steadily.

src: 青海省农业农村厅副厅长杨林介绍，截至目前，青海湖裸鲤已累计实施人工增殖放流近1.8亿尾，对青海湖裸鲤资源恢复的贡献率超过23 % 。

chosen.text: Qianling, Deputy Director of the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau of Qinghai Province, introduced that to date, over 180 million fry of Qinghai Lake huchen have been implemented in artificial spawning and release efforts, contributing more than 23% to the recovery of the Qinghai Lake huchen resource.

src: 青海三江源地区是我国乃至亚洲重要的生态屏障和水源涵养区，而青海湖是控制西部荒漠化向东蔓延的天然屏障和生态功能区。

chosen.text: The Qinghai Three-River Source region is an important ecological barrier and water source conservation area not only for China but also for Asia, while Lake Qinghai serves as a natural barrier against desertification spreading eastward and an ecological functional zone.

src: 为了保护三江源地区和青海湖水域生态环境、保护水生野生动物，维护青藏高原生物多样性，今年以来，青海先后发布长江、黄河、青海湖重点水域禁捕通告，构建起了“一江一河一湖”全面禁捕管理体系。

chosen.text: To protect the ecological environment of the Three River Source region and Qinghai Lake waters, to protect aquatic wildlife, and to maintain biodiversity in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, since this year, Qinghai has successively issued notices banning fishing in key waters of the Yangtze River, Yellow River, and Qinghai Lake, establishing a comprehensive ban on fishing management system for “one river, one river, one lake.”

src: 时间长度、血量、痛经程度因人而异，有些人三天，有些人一周；有些人流的少，有些人大血崩；有些人没什么反应，有些人疼到救护车运走，痛经随着时间会改变，以前不痛不代表一辈子不痛。

chosen.text: The duration of time, blood loss, and severity of menstrual cramps vary from person to person; some experience it for three days, while others for a week; some lose very little blood, while others have heavy bleeding; some feel no discomfort, while others suffer so much that they need to be transported by ambulance. Menstrual cramps can change over time; just because it was not painful before does not mean it will never be painful in the future.

src: 月经无法控制，开始到结束为止的几天内24小时流血，能做的只有用卫生巾或卫生棉条吸血防止流到衣服椅子上。

chosen.text: Menstruation is uncontrollable, with blood flowing continuously for days from start to end; the only thing one can do is use sanitary napkins or tampons to absorb the blood to prevent it from spilling onto clothes or chairs.

src: 痛经主要是因为前列腺素的分泌，生理期刚开始还没来得及痛经时赶紧吃布洛芬可有效缓解当月疼痛，痛经开始后再吃没什么用。

chosen.text: Menstrual cramps are mainly caused by prostaglandin secretion. Taking ibuprofen immediately at the beginning of menstruation can effectively relieve the pain for that month, but taking it after the cramps begin is ineffective.

src: 生理期前由于子宫充血和前列腺素释放过多，容易拉肚子。

chosen.text: During the pre-menstrual period, diarrhea can occur due to uterine congestion and excessive release of prostaglandins.

src: 如果大概到了周期，莫名其妙拉肚子，基本上两天内会来月经。

chosen.text: If it happens around the time of her cycle, and for no apparent reason she starts having diarrhea, she will likely get her period within two days.

src: 卫生巾最好两三个小时更换一次，不然容易滋生细菌，除去睡眠时间，最坏的情况是一天更换6次，每月7天，那就是42片，如果加上提前准备的份可能有50片，并不是每个月用一片。

chosen.text: Sanitary napkins should be changed every two to three hours, otherwise bacteria can easily grow. Excluding sleep time, the worst-case scenario is changing them six times a day for 7 days, which totals 42 pads. If you add in the extra pads prepared in advance, it might be up to 50 pads, not using just one pad per month.

src: （此处修改一下，卫生棉条不必常换，大概五六小时换一次就可以，最长八小时）

chosen.text: (The modification being made is that sanitary pads do not need to be changed frequently; about every five to six hours is sufficient, with a maximum of eight hours.)

src: 月经期荷尔蒙作祟可能会比较暴躁，排卵期也会因为体内激素变化情绪不稳定，就是很倒霉，身体给自己使绊子。

chosen.text: Menstrual hormones can make you moody, and ovulation can also be unstable due to hormonal changes, which is just bad luck as your body is working against you.

src: 但官方犯罪率数据能看出女性控制情绪的能力还是很高的，也不会拿情绪问题找借口。

chosen.text: But official crime rates show that women still possess high levels of emotional control and do not use emotional issues as an excuse.

src: 流的并不只是血，其中包含脱落的子宫内膜。

chosen.text: What flows is not just blood; it includes detached uterine lining.

src: 月经结束后的子宫内膜最薄，之后慢慢变厚，可以理解为子宫是房子，每个月建房子（内膜变厚）准备迎接客人，客人没有来，全部拆掉（月经排出）下个月再建新房子，周而复始。

chosen.text: The endometrium of the uterus is thinnest after menstruation and gradually thickens again, which can be understood as the uterus being like a house that gets built each month (thickening of the endometrium) to welcome guests. When the guests do not arrive, everything is dismantled (menstrual discharge), and a new house is built every month, repeating this cycle.

src: 月经很不方便，连续几十年，每个月几天24小时流血，还会腹痛腰痛，谁愿意？

chosen.text: Menstruation is very inconvenient, lasting for decades with bleeding for several days every month, accompanied by abdominal pain and backache. Who would want that?

src: 但是人能出生是因为他的母亲来过月经，月经是为了准备你第一次来到这个世界时要住10个月的房子，大家要感谢自己的母亲规律健康的来过月经。

chosen.text: But people are born because their mother has had menstruation. Menstruation is to prepare the house you will live in for ten months when you first come into this world. Everyone should thank their mothers for having regular and healthy periods.

src: 以前女性的很多事情被打压，社会给女性洗脑说是肮脏的，羞耻的，大家以为就是那样了，但时代变了。

chosen.text: In the past, many things that women did were suppressed, and society brainwashed them into thinking these were dirty and shameful. Everyone thought that was just the way it was, but times have changed.

src: 如果有人觉得月经恶心，觉得女性的身体为孕育生命做出的准备行为恶心，不该在大庭广众之下说出来，女孩子们站起来，不要再这么想，从未经历过，这辈子也不会经历，也不怎么了解的男性们，不要那么忘恩负义不知好歹，这种态度怎么好意思面对自己的母亲，怎么好意思想要自己的孩子？

chosen.text: If anyone finds menstruation repulsive and considers the bodily preparation for conception by women as disgusting and inappropriate to discuss in public, girls should stand up and stop thinking like that. Men who have never experienced it nor will in this lifetime and know very little about it should not be so ungrateful and uncaring. How can one face their mother with such an attitude, or want their child when harboring such thoughts?

src: 最后，姐妹们试试卫生棉条吧，真的好用。

chosen.text: Lastly, try out sanitary pads, they really work well.

src: 后来他联络了商家，商家的态度还不错，尽管退掉了足浴盆，李先生依然感到不快。

src: 但是一般情况下足浴盆是不会有带电问题的，但也不排除少数产品在出厂时没有严格把关。

src: 因此在在购买的时候选择分体式的足浴盆。

src: 水电分离，没有任何安全隐患。

src: 形而上学是指通过理性的推理和逻辑去研究不能直接透过感知而得到答案的问题。

chosen.text: Metaphysics is the study of questions that cannot be directly answered through perception using rational inference and logic.

src: 形而上学是哲学的基本法则，旨在解释存在和世界的基本性质。

chosen.text: Metaphysics is the fundamental law of philosophy aimed at explaining the basic nature of existence and the world.

src: 中文译名“形而上学”取自《易经•系辞上传》“形而上者谓之道，形而下者谓之器”一语，为日本人井上哲次郎（明治时代）由metaphysic翻译而来。

chosen.text: The Chinese term "形而上学" is derived from the phrase "形而上者谓之道，形而下者谓之器" in The易经•系辞上传 of the I Ching, which was translated by the Japanese thinker Kenkichi Ikeno (during the Meiji period) as "metaphysic."

src: 形而上学分支包括本体论、自然神学及其延伸问题等。

chosen.text: The branches of metaphysics include ontology, natural theology, and related issues.

src: 本体论就是“研究到底哪些名词代表真实的存在实体，哪些名词只是代表一种概念”。

chosen.text: Ontology is the study of “which nouns represent real existent entities and which nouns merely represent concepts.”

src: 形而上学自然主义，指否认上帝存在。

chosen.text: Metaphysical naturalism, which denies the existence of God.

src: 其理论基础认为所有现象皆可用自然理由的概念解释，由支持科学和演化论的哲学家提出。

chosen.text: Its theoretical foundation posits that all phenomena can be explained by natural reasons, a concept advanced by philosophers who support science and evolution.

src: 而方法自然主义指对上帝不置一词的研究方法。

chosen.text: And method naturalism refers to a research method that speaks not a word about God.

src: 精神哲学是研究意识以及它们与肉体（尤其是大脑）的关系的本质的哲学分支。

chosen.text: Philosophy of mind is the branch of philosophy that studies the essence of consciousness and its relationship with the body (especially the brain).

src: 二元论与一元论是讨论“心灵与肉体的关系”最主要的两派思想。

chosen.text: Dualism and monism are the main schools of thought discussing “the relationship between mind and body.”

src: 知识论是探讨知识的本质、起源和范围的一个哲学分支。

chosen.text: Epistemology is a branch of philosophy that explores the nature, origin, and scope of knowledge.

src: 伦理学是对人类道德生活进行系统性思考和研究的学科；在这里，道德定义为一群人或一种文化所认可的所有行为准则。

chosen.text: Ethics is a discipline that systematically thinks and studies about human moral life; here, morality refers to all behavioral norms that are recognized by a group of people or a culture.

src: 主要分为元伦理学（抽象地研究伦理理论或批判的本质）、规范伦理学（评判各种不同的道德观，并且对于正确或错误行为给出道德准则建议。

chosen.text: Mainly divided into meta-ethics (abstractly studying ethical theories or criticizing their essence) and normative ethics (evaluating various different moral views and offering moral guidelines for correct or incorrect behaviors).

src: 它研究人们应该遵守什么样式的道德行为准则）、应用伦理学（将伦理理论应用于实际生活状况的学术，包括生物伦理学、政治伦理学等）、描述伦理学（搜集关于人们怎样生活的信息，从观察到的样式来作总结。

chosen.text: It explores what kind of moral behavioral codes people should adhere to), applied ethics (an academic field that applies ethical theories to actual life situations, including bioethics and political ethics), and descriptive ethics (collecting information about how people live, summarizing from observed patterns.)

src: 它对于伦理的检视不是从预想的理论出发，而是调查实际道德主体（moral agent）所做出、并且被观察到的真实抉择，促成了这决择的所有道德因素，它研讨社会族群所持有的伦理观）。

chosen.text: Its examination of ethics is not from an anticipated theoretical standpoint but from investigating actual moral subjects (moral agents) who make and are observed to make real choices, considering all the moral factors that underlie these decisions, it explores the ethical views held by social groups.

src: 伦理学历史包括希腊罗马伦理学、中世纪基督教伦理学。

chosen.text: The history of ethics includes Greek and Roman ethics, medieval Christian ethics.

src: 第一部分：人文主义的伦理思想，以瓦拉与蒙田等人为代表。

chosen.text: Part 1: Humanist ethical thought, represented by authors such as Valla and Montaigne.

src: 第二部分：宗教改革的伦理思想，以加尔文为代表。

chosen.text: Second Part: The Ethical Thought of the Reformation, Represented by Calvin.

src: 第三部分：政治的伦理学，以马基雅维利等人为代表、近代伦理学（17-18世纪，英国经验主义伦理学，代表人物：休谟等，17-18世纪，欧陆理性主义伦理学，代表人物：斯宾诺莎等，18世纪，法国启蒙派伦理学，代表人物：伏尔泰等，18-19世纪，德国学院派伦理学，代表人物：康德与黑格尔等，18-19世纪，英国功利主义伦理学，代表人物：边沁与西基维克等，19世纪，英国进化论伦理学，代表人物：史宾塞与赫胥黎等，19世纪后期，德国新康德主义伦理学，代表人物：李凯儿等，19世纪后期，新黑格尔主义伦理学，代表人物：托马斯·希尔·格林等）、过渡时期伦理学（非理性主义伦理学，代表人物：克尔凯郭儿、叔本华与尼采等）。

chosen.text: Third Part: Political Ethics, represented by Machiavelli and others, Modern Ethics (17-18th century, British Empiricism Ethics, representatives: Hume, etc., 17-18th century, Rationalist Ethics in Europe, representatives: Spinoza, etc., 18th century, Enlightenment Ethics in France, representatives: Voltaire, etc., 18-19th century, German Academic Ethics, representatives: Kant and Hegel, etc., 18-19th century, British Utilitarian Ethics, representatives: Bentham and Sidgwick, etc., 19th century, Evolutionary Ethics in Britain, representatives: Spencer and Huxley, etc., late 19th century, New Kantian Ethics in Germany, representatives: Liebknecht, etc., late 19th century, New Hegelian Ethics, representatives: T. H. Green, etc.), Transitional Ethics (Nihilistic Ethics, representatives: Kierkegaard, Schopenhauer, and Nietzsche, etc.).

src: 逻辑学是研究“有效推论和证明的原则与标准”的一门学科。

chosen.text: Logic is the discipline that studies “the principles and standards of valid inference and proof.”

src: 逻辑通常包括三个部份：归纳推理、溯因推理和演绎推理，可分为形式逻辑和非形式逻辑。

chosen.text: Logic typically consists of three parts: inductive reasoning, abductive reasoning, and deductive reasoning, which can be classified as formal logic and non-formal logic.

src: 美学是以对美的本质及其意义的研究为主题的学科。

src: 本人在此衷心感谢各位朋友在我们亲人遇难后的30多年漫长期间内所给予的人道救助，尤其是在我1994年初曾以个人名义向国内外友人发出过人道救助呼吁以来，迄今为止未曾中断的救助。

chosen.text: I sincerely thank all our friends for their humanitarian assistance over the past 30+ years, especially since I issued a call for humanitarian aid both domestically and internationally in 1994 under my personal name, and the continuous support that has never ceased until now.

src: 现如今绝大多数遇难者的老父母均已谢世，遗孤们也已长大成家就业。

chosen.text: Nowadays, the elderly parents of most victims have already passed away, and orphans have grown up, married, and entered the workforce.

src: 是你们的义举帮助我们这些蒙难家庭度过了最为艰难的时刻。

chosen.text: It was your act of kindness that helped us, these beleaguered families, through our most difficult times.

src: 目前新冠疫情正在全球肆虐，大多数的捐款者也已年届退休。

chosen.text: The current pandemic is raging globally, and most donors are already in retirement age.

src: 因此，我恳切地请求你们中止给我们难属——天安门母亲群体人道捐款，这项人道救助活动早就应该画上完美的句号了。

chosen.text: Therefore, I earnestly request you to suspend your humanitarian donations to us, the Tiananmen Mothers, as this humanitarian aid effort should have concluded with a perfect closure long ago.

src: 我将永远铭记你们的爱心，并坚信你们的义举必将为历史铭记。

chosen.text: I shall forever remember your kindness and believe that your deeds will be etched into history.

src: 由于种种原因，我只能以此方式表达自己的意愿，请朋友们谅解！

chosen.text: For various reasons, I can only express my wishes in this way, please understand my friends!

src: 请接受我诚挚的祝福。

chosen.text: Accept my sincere blessings.

chosen.text: Qwen: Tao notes here that, with this opportunity, he would like to provide a brief introduction to the 32-year history of humanitarian aid undertaken by the International Federation of Chinese Scholars (IFCSS) and the Minnesota Chinese Democracy Foundation (MCDF).

chosen.text: During humanitarian aid efforts, the American Association of Universities and the Minnesota China Democracy Foundation are parallel organizations with sometimes overlapping executors.

src: 救助款常常不能顺利送达六四难属手中。

chosen.text: Relief funds often fail to reach the hands of the June 4th victims smoothly.

src: 1994年，经丁老师建议，由“天安门母亲”成立专门小组，统筹和负责人道救助款的接收与分发。

chosen.text: In 1994, under the suggestion of Teacher Ding, the Tiananmen Mothers established a special group to coordinate and manage the receipt and distribution of humanitarian aid funds.

src: 1998年，MCDF设立《六四孤儿教育基金》，执行11年后，于2009年，在所有六四孤儿都大学毕业后，MCDF继而设立《六四孤苦老人特困户救助基金》，并一直执行至今。

chosen.text: In 1998, MCDF established the "Orphan Fund for the June 4th Education," which was executed for 11 years before MCDF set up the "Special Assistance Fund for the Hard-pressed June 4th Widows and Orphans" after all the June 4th orphans had graduated from university in 2009, and it has been continuously implemented since then.

src: 这些项目的资金，主要来自六四当年的校园和社会捐款，来自个人的慷慨捐助，并受到兄弟大学民主基金会的支持。

chosen.text: The funds for these projects mainly came from donations made on campuses and in society during June Fourth, generous individual contributions, and were supported by the Democratic Foundation of Sister Universities.

src: 自2018年起，还得到了劳改研究基金会的支持。

chosen.text: Since 2018, it has also received support from the Prison Reform Research Foundation.

src: 直到去年，时隔31年后，六四难属们终于收到了一笔来自香港的当年以六四的名义募捐来的部分捐款。

chosen.text: It was not until last year that the Six Four victims finally received some of the partial donations collected under the name of June 4th in Hong Kong, over 31 years after the event.

src: 在此期间，《中国人权》也在独立地执行它们的人道救助项目。

chosen.text: During this time, the "Human Rights in China" also carried out its humanitarian aid projects independently.

src: 我们理解，丁老师叫停六四捐助，是为捐款人考虑，我们也确实都是一些退休老人，收入并非如退休前充裕，特此对丁老师的“致友人”一信表示感谢。

chosen.text: We understand that Teacher Ding stopped the donations for June 4th out of consideration for the donors, and we are indeed some retired individuals whose income is not as plentiful as it was before retirement. We hereby express our gratitude for Teacher Ding's letter to his friends.

src: 我们会尊重难属们的决定，在两年内终止这一项目，并在需要时，立即恢复。

chosen.text: We will respect the decision of the minorities and terminate this project within two years, and reinstate it immediately when necessary.

src: 对于那些多年来一直坚持慷慨解囊，冒着风险递送人道救助款的那些侠肝义胆的同道们，一并表示感谢和敬意。

src: 新华社利雅得12月12日电（记者王海洲 胡冠）沙特阿拉伯首届当代艺术双年展 — — 迪里耶当代艺术双年展，于11日在位于沙特首都利雅得西北部的迪里耶JAX艺术区正式向公众开放，共有来自沙特、中国等地的64位艺术家参展。

chosen.text: Xinhua Riyadh, December 12 – (By Wang Haizhou and Hu Guan) The first Contemporary Art Biennial in Saudi Arabia, Diriyah Contemporary Art Biennial, officially opened to the public on November 1st at the JAX Art District in Diriyah, located northwest of Saudi capital Riyadh. Featuring works by 64 artists from Saudi Arabia and other parts of the world, the exhibition has started.

src: 本次双年展由沙特迪里耶双年展基金会和中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心联合策划，中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心馆长田霏宇担任艺术总监。

chosen.text: This biennial exhibition is co-curated by the Diyar Biennial Foundation of Saudi Arabia and UCCA Center for Contemporary Art in China, with director Tian Fei-yu serving as the artistic director.

src: 据策展团队介绍，本次双年展的主题为“摸着石头过河 ” ， 隐喻社会经济转型时期所采取的改革策略，也反映沙特社会文化发展的当下境遇。

chosen.text: According to the curatorial team, the theme of this biennial exhibition is "Crossing the river by feeling for stones," which metaphorically refers to the reform strategies adopted during periods of social and economic transition, and also reflects the current situation of Saudi society and culture.

src: 本次双年展占地近12000平方米，展厅横跨六个相互连接的建筑，以六个单元呈现 ： 《 摸着石头过河 》 《 传承作为实验 》 《 边缘思考 》 《 走向公众 》 《 美丽新世界》以及《论艺术的精神 》 。

chosen.text: This biennial exhibition covers nearly 12,000 square meters and spans six interconnected buildings, presenting six units: “Crossing the River by Feeling for Stones,” “Tradition as Experiment,” “Thinking at the Margin,” “Engaging the Public,” “A Beautiful New World,” and “On the Spirit of Art.”

src: 其中，27位沙特艺术家的作品数量占本次展品总量的四成以上，囊括绘画、装置艺术和表演艺术等多种形式；12位中国艺术家的作品同样备受关注，有的艺术家以新颖的方式使用回收材料进行创作，例如徐冰在《背后的故事系列之溪山无尽图 》 （ 2014）中，用废弃物重构了一幅经典山水画。

chosen.text: Among them, the number of works by 27 Saudi artists accounts for more than four-fifths of the total exhibition, covering various forms such as painting, installation art, and performance art; twelve Chinese artists' works also garnered significant attention, with some using recycled materials in innovative ways, such as Cai Guoqiang who, in his work "The Series Behind the Story - The Unfathomable Mountain Stream Landscape" (2014), re-constructed a classic landscape painting using waste materials.

src: 迪里耶双年展基金会首席执行官巴克利表示，希望本届双年展能够建立国际对话，让全球观众有机会了解沙特蓬勃发展的文化产业和创意社区，加强互动往来。

chosen.text: Chief Executive of the Dijlah Biennial Foundation, Buckley, said that he hoped this edition of the biennial would establish an international dialogue, giving global audiences the opportunity to understand Saudi Arabia's burgeoning cultural and creative industries and communities, and fostering greater interactions.

src: 田霏宇说 ： “ 双年展的目标是双重的，既能让沙特当代艺术参与全球对话，也能让沙特观众融入当代艺术世界 。 ”

chosen.text: Tian Feiyu said: "The goal of the biennial is two-fold: to involve contemporary Saudi art in global conversations and to enable Saudi audiences to engage with the world of contemporary art."

src: 据了解，在双年展开幕周期间还将举办系列讲座，艺术家、策展人和创意行业的意见领袖将就跨文化交流、当代艺术发展等主题展开讨论。

chosen.text: It is reported that during the run-up to the biennial exhibition, there will also be a series of lectures where artists, curators, and leaders in the creative industry will discuss topics such as cross-cultural exchange and the development of contemporary art.

src: 云南：统筹规范乡村公益性岗位管理-新华网

chosen.text: Yunnan: Coordinated and standardized management of rural public welfare positions - Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社昆明12月12日电（记者林碧锋）为持续做好脱贫人口就业帮扶，巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果，云南省日前出台促进乡村振兴乡村公益性岗位管理相关政策，助力全面推进乡村振兴。

chosen.text: Xinhua News Agency, Kunming, Dec. 12 (Xinhua) — To continue doing employment assistance for people who have been lifted out of poverty and to consolidate and expand the results of poverty alleviation, Yunnan province recently issued policies on the management of rural public welfare positions to help advance the comprehensive revitalization of rural areas.

src: 云南省人社厅有关负责人介绍，目前，云南共开发44.83万个乡村公益性岗位，用于安置脱贫劳动力等农村困难群体就业，在帮助脱贫群众实现就业增收、巩固脱贫攻坚成果、有效提升乡村各项公共服务能力等方面发挥重要作用。

chosen.text: Related officials from the Yunnan Provincial People's Office said that at present, Yunnan has developed a total of 44,830,000 rural public benefit jobs to accommodate rural hardworking groups such as the poverty-stricken labour force, which play an important role in helping poverty-stricken people achieve job growth, consolidate the achievements of poverty alleviation, and effectively enhance public service capacities in rural areas.

src: 此次新规由云南人社、乡村振兴、财政等七部门联合印发，主要对基层招聘乡村公益性岗位人员的对象范围、资金管理、岗位开发、岗位管理等方面进行统一规范。

chosen.text: This new regulation was jointly issued by seven departments including the Yunnan Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, Rural Revitalization Commission, and Finance Department, aiming to unify standards for the scope of individuals hired for village public welfare positions, fund management, position development, and position management at the grassroots level.

src: 在岗位开发设置方面，新规明确，按照“按需设岗、以岗定人、动态管理、总量控制 ” “ 谁开发、谁使用、谁负责”及“一人一岗、自愿公开、统一管理”的原则进行设置。

chosen.text: Regarding position development settings, the new rules clarify that positions should be set according to the principles of “need-driven positioning, job-based staffing, dynamic management, and total control,” “who develops, who uses, and who is responsible,” as well as “one person, one job, voluntary disclosure, and unified management.”

src: 招聘程序必须按照公告、申报、审核、公示、聘用、岗前培训及安排上岗等步骤进行。

chosen.text: The recruitment process must follow steps such as announcement, application, review, public display, appointment, pre-employment training, and assignment to duty.

src: 此外，新规还明确了乡村公益性岗位主要开发部门的具体职责、乡村公益性岗位的补贴标准和补贴方式，规定各乡村公益性岗位开发部门应为乡村公益性岗位安置人员购买意外伤害商业保险；要求有关部门定期对乡村公益性岗位补贴发放情况进行监督。

chosen.text: Furthermore, the new regulations clarify the specific responsibilities of the main departments responsible for developing rural public-interest positions, the subsidy standards and methods for these positions, and stipulate that each department responsible for developing rural public-interest positions should purchase commercial insurance for the individuals they have placed in such positions; they also require relevant authorities to regularly oversee the distribution of subsidies for rural public-interest positions.

src: 左右我觉得一般是指约束和自由，中国从历史文化的先天基因导致中国整体应该是偏左。

src: 近两年，美帝对华为芯片的封锁和围堵，不仅让华为陷入前所未有的困境，也让“美系”企业遭遇巨大的损失。

chosen.text: In the past two years, the US's blockade and encirclement of Huawei's chips have not only left Huawei in an unprecedented predicament but also resulted in significant losses for "US-based" enterprises.

src: 美帝打压中国芯片产业，要求自家企业及盟友国相关企业同时对我国芯片产业进行封锁，直接导致的后果就是全球芯片供应商的订单和利润受到影响，造成芯片生产企业的研发投入降低、产能下降，从而造成了全球范围内芯片供应链的短缺的紊乱。

chosen.text: Meitlin's crackdown on the Chinese chip industry, demanding that its own companies and allied companies simultaneously block China's chip industry, directly resulted in orders and profits being affected by global chip suppliers, resulting in a decrease in R&D and capacity for chip manufacturing companies, resulting in a shortage of chip supply chains worldwide.

src: 如今“缺芯”已经波及到了全球各大行业，比如车企停产、手机涨价，几乎所有用到芯片的行业都深受其害。

chosen.text: Today, "chip shortage" has affected virtually every sector worldwide, from carmakers halting production to rising prices for smartphones, with almost every industry that relies on chips suffering its consequences.

src: 为了掌握“芯片”自主权，越来越多国家的科技巨头开始走向“去美化”的道路。

chosen.text: To secure “chip” autonomy, more tech giants from around the world are taking a “de-Americanized” path.

src: 为了牢牢把控全球半导体控制权，牵制中国半导体行业的发展，最近老美动作频频，又是主持“芯片峰会”；又是邀请64国巨头成立半导体联盟，并拔款扶持美国本土科技巨头，比如，美帝老牌科技巨头英特尔为了夺回在芯片领域的主导地位，斥资200亿美元在美国亚利桑那州建2座晶圆加工厂，并对外开放芯片代工业务。

chosen.text: To firmly grasp global semiconductor control and curb the development of China's semiconductor industry, recent U.S. actions have been frequent. This includes hosting a “chip summit”; inviting major CEOs from 64 countries to establish a semiconductor alliance; and allocating funding to support U.S. tech giants. For example, longtime U.S. technology giant Intel, aiming to regain dominance in the chip sector, invested $20 billion to build two semiconductor foundries in Arizona and opened up its chip manufacturing business to the public.

src: 当大多数人都以为，英特尔此番举动将对台积电造成一定冲击，并很有可能抢走台积电的“饭碗”。

chosen.text: When most thought that Intel’s move would have some impact on TSMC and possibly steal TSMC’s “main dish.”

src: 之所以这么肯定，是因为，英特尔作为美帝老牌科技巨头，在半导体领域深耕几十年，拥有大量的人才队伍和技术储备，必定能在短期内迅速崛起，打败台积电。

chosen.text: It is so certain because Intel, as an old giant in American tech, has been deeply involved in the semiconductor field for decades and possesses a large pool of talent and technological reserves; it is bound to rise quickly and defeat TSMC in the short term.

src: 然而，对于英特尔的这个决定，台积电创始人张忠谋却不屑一顾。

chosen.text: However, Taiwan Semiconductor founder Morris Chang is not impressed with Intel’s decision.

src: 在今年四月举行的“2021大师智库论坛”上，张忠谋语出惊人，对于英特尔斥资建晶圆厂这个举动，张忠谋毫无顾忌直言：英特尔建芯片代工厂，相当讽刺。

chosen.text: At the "2021 Masters Think Tank Forum" held in April, Tsou Maw-Kuo made a startling statement regarding Intel's investment in building a semiconductor foundry. Tsou bluntly said that Intel's move to build a chip manufacturing plant is quite ironic.

src: 张忠谋之所以对英特尔进军晶圆领域颇为不屑，是因为张忠谋对30多年前台积电与英特尔的一段恩怨依然耿耿于怀。

chosen.text: Chan Chung-mou was dismissive of Intel’s foray into wafer manufacturing because he remains resentful of a grudge from 30 years ago when TSMC and Intel had a contentious relationship.

src: 上世纪六七十年代，英特尔一直是美帝制造业中的明珠，雄居全球巅峰的位置，是世界半导体领域的霸主。

chosen.text: In the 1960s and 1970s, Intel was a shining gem in American manufacturing, occupying the top position globally and the dominant force in the world's semiconductor sector.

src: 到上世纪80年代，世界半导体高端芯片一直被少数强者掌握。

chosen.text: By the 1980s, the world's high-end semiconductor chips were largely dominated by a few strong players.

src: 当时半导体行业以IDM模式为特征，芯片从设计、制造到封测都是由一家工厂来完成，英特尔就是那个时代的代表。

chosen.text: At that time, the semiconductor industry was characterized by the IDM model, where chips were designed, manufactured, and tested by a single factory. Intel was the representative of that era.

src: 然而这样的模式让一些小企业不堪重负，很多半导体创业者面对巨额的产线建设费用只能望而却步。

chosen.text: However, this model imposes too heavy a burden on small enterprises, and many semiconductor entrepreneurs are deterred from building their own production lines due to huge construction costs.

src: 在市场需求的感召下，进入80年代后，芯片行业开始出现分工合作的现象，1984年张忠谋听说有专门做芯片设计的公司，便认为既然有专门做设计的，那么就可以成立一家专门用于晶圆制造的工厂。

chosen.text: Driven by market demand, the semiconductor industry began to exhibit phenomena of division of labor and cooperation after entering the 1980s. In 1984, Zhang Zhongmo heard that there were companies specializing in chip design, and he believed that since there was already a company for design, it would be possible to establish a factory specifically for wafer manufacturing.

src: 不久之后，张忠谋的设想变成了现实，台积电应运而生。

chosen.text: Not long after, Zhang Zhongmo’s vision became a reality, and TSMC was born.

src: 台积电把主营业务瞄准了“晶圆加工”这个单一环节，不进行设计，只提供晶圆制造的代工服务。

chosen.text: TSMC focuses its core business on “wafer fabrication” as a single stage, without designing, it solely provides foundry services for wafer manufacturing.

src: 当时刚创立的台积电，在英特尔这个巨无霸面前就是小喽啰。

chosen.text: When it was first founded, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) was just a minor player in the face of Intel, the behemoth.

src: 为了获取资本支持，张忠谋就曾找英特尔投资，但当时英特尔一听说台积电只做芯片行业的制造环节，显然有些自视甚高，看不起台积电，果断拒绝对台积电进行投资。

chosen.text: To secure capital support, Zhang Zhongmu even approached Intel Capital to invest in TSMC, but when Intel heard that TSMC was only involved in the manufacturing segment of the semiconductor industry, it seemed too proud and looked down on TSMC, hence decisively refusing to invest in the company.

src: 张忠谋也认定英特尔当时是看不起晶圆制程服务的。

chosen.text: Zhang Zhongmu also believed that Intel had looked down upon wafer fabrication services at the time.

src: 没想到当年看不起晶圆制造服务的巨头，如今却也要开始做晶圆代工。

chosen.text: Never expected that the giant who once looked down on foundry services for semiconductor manufacturing would now have to start doing foundry themselves.

src: 所以，张忠谋觉得英特尔进入晶圆代工很讽刺。

chosen.text: So, Zhang Zhongmei found it ironic that Intel entered foundry manufacturing.

src: 如今台积电的市值已经超过了英特尔。

chosen.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company's (TSMC) market value has already surpassed that of Intel.

src: 面对台积电的强势进攻，英特尔自然也是不敢固步自封。

chosen.text: Facing Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company’s strong offensive, Intel naturally cannot afford to rest on its laurels either.

src: 如今，台积电已经向着3nm芯片冲刺，而英特尔仍然停留在7年前的14nm。

chosen.text: Now, TSMC is racing towards 3nm chips, while Intel is still stuck at 14nm from seven years ago.

src: 想要赶超其实并非易事。

chosen.text: To catch up is not an easy task.

chosen.text: Most meteor showers have their parent bodies in the form of periodic comets, but the Orionids' parent body is the 3200 Phaethon asteroid, which is an Apollo-type asteroid.

chosen.text: Shengli Peng, an astronomer and science popularizer of the Tianjin Astronomical Society, explains that much like a New Year’s blockbuster film, the December conjunction meteor shower appears around the end of the year, with its “release date” lasting from December 4th to the 17th.

src: 该流星雨以流量大且稳定著称，与象限仪流星雨、英仙座流星雨一起被称为北半球三大流星雨。

src: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：

chosen.text: In my understanding, the traditional TV that the OP is referring to is likely a LCD TV, and the differences in market positioning between laser TVs and LCD TVs mainly include the following two points:

src: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。

chosen.text: In contrast to the all-encompassing market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are clearly more focused on the large-screen market, or in essence, laser TVs were born for large screens.

src: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。

chosen.text: Currently, mainstream LCD TVs are typically in the 55-inch to 65-inch range, while laser TVs generally come in sizes of 75 inches or larger, with some models exceeding 100 inches, fully meeting users' demand for big-screen TVs.

src: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。

src: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。

src: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。

chosen.text: The excellent performance of laser TVs in terms of eye protection is largely responsible for this good performance in the big screen market.

src: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。

chosen.text: Based on the imaging principle of laser televisions that use diffuse reflection from lasers, the light emitted by the laser source does not directly enter the eye, and compared to the backlighting of LCD TVs, the imaging process is closer to how objects would naturally be imaged, producing less stimulation to the eye.

src: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。

chosen.text: The China Electronics Technology Standardization Research Institute's SASTI Laboratory and ophthalmologists from Beijing Tongren Hospital conducted a rigorous comparative test of laser TVs and LCD TVs under the same conditions, resulting in 144 sets of testing data.

src: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。

chosen.text: Data confirms: Laser TVs indeed have strong eye protection properties, and in certain aspects, they even possess some improving effects.

src: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。

chosen.text: With increasing emphasis on eye health, laser TVs have attracted an ever-growing number of users not only due to their eye-friendly features but also opened up another avenue in the TV market.

src: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。

chosen.text: Second, laser TVs target the high-end market more.

src: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。

chosen.text: Contrary to the continuous decline in LCD TV prices, currently available laser TVs typically cost over ten thousand yuan, with prices gradually increasing as screen sizes and light sources improve.

src: 激光电视凭什么卖这么贵呢？

chosen.text: Why are laser TVs so expensive?

src: 肯定是有道理的。

chosen.text: It is certainly reasonable.

src: 在光源和技术水平的不断发展下，激光电视有很多液晶电视和投影都无法实现的优势。

chosen.text: With advancements in light sources and technologies, laser TVs have several advantages that LCD TVs and projectors cannot achieve.

src: 凭借超短焦距投影技术，激光电视的投影距离相对传统投影设备来说要更短，能够在短距离内实现100英寸大屏体验，所需空间不大，而且主机小巧，占用地方很小。

chosen.text: With ultra-short throw projection technology, laser TVs have a shorter projection distance compared to traditional projection devices, allowing for a 100-inch screen experience at short distances with minimal space required, and the host is compact, occupying a small area.

src: 在亮度方面，大品牌激光电视可以达到2000以上的流明。

chosen.text: In terms of brightness, high-brand laser TVs can reach over 2000 lumens.

src: 加之发热量更低，对设备损耗小，电视的使用寿命也更长。

chosen.text: Furthermore, with lower heat generation and lesser equipment wear, TV lifespan is also prolonged.

src: 除此之外，很多高端激光电视机型还搭载了真4K超高清画质、人工智能系统、仿生屏等众多前沿技术，能够给用户带来更震撼的视听体验。

chosen.text: Moreover, many high-end laser TV models come equipped with true 4K ultra-high definition picture quality, artificial intelligence systems, and lifelike screens, among other cutting-edge technologies, which can offer users a more immersive audio-visual experience.

src: 谈不上伪需求，而是需求细分的产物，论画质和投入产出比，激光电视不是影音玩家的菜，想兼顾大屏和观看环境不足，可以尝试，凡事皆有利弊，权衡过后自己判断即可，就怕听信一面之词。

chosen.text: It's not a case of false demand but rather the result of demand segmentation. In terms of picture quality and return on investment, laser TVs aren't suited for audiovisual enthusiasts. If you want to balance big screens with poor viewing environments, you can give it a try. Everything has its pros and cons; weigh the options yourself after considering them, lest you fall prey to one-sided information.

src: 简单说，超广角近焦投影机--激光电视，为了贴近幕布，不得不使用价格昂贵的超广角透镜和反射镜，这不符合光学最佳设计。

chosen.text: Simply put, ultra-wide angle short-throw projectors – such as laser TVs, which have to use expensive ultra-wide-angle lenses and mirrors to project close to the screen, do not adhere to optimal optical design.

src: 为了屏蔽部分环境光，使用微结构的菲涅尔幕布，代价高昂，80寸的价格基本能换个65寸液晶。

chosen.text: To block some ambient light, using microstructured Fresnel screens is expensive, and an 80-inch model is basically equivalent to a 65-inch LCD screen in price.

src: 还有一点，我特别讨厌投影厂商拿漫反射对眼睛好这种当卖点，拜托，眼睛能够看到的幕布上的光线对于眼睛而言就是直射光，你漫反射到天花板上，眼睛也看不到，非要较真液晶电视也是漫“直射”，打开电视天花板不也被照亮吗？

chosen.text: One more thing, I really hate how projector manufacturers tout diffuse reflection being good for your eyes as a selling point. Please, the light reflecting off a screen that your eyes can see is essentially direct glare; even if you diffuse it to the ceiling, your eyes won’t see it, and isn’t a regular LCD also considered to have "diffuse direct" lighting? When you turn on the TV, doesn’t the ceiling get illuminated anyway?

src: 而且，投影幕布如果不是漫反射，根本成不了像。

chosen.text: And, if the projection screen is not diffuse, it cannot form an image.

src: 恰恰被忽略了高增益幕布的热斑（光斑）效应，某一角度大量光线反射到眼睛，那才是真难受。

chosen.text: The hot spot (glare) effect of high-gain screens, where a large amount of light is reflected at a certain angle and hurts the eyes, has been overlooked.

Ultimately, we decided to start with makeup and styling. Before the photographer took pictures, they would set some props and guide the poses, paying very close attention to all the details.

src: 但是可能因为没和我交流具体的拍摄想法，所以拍出来的不是我想要的风格，但是应该是好看的🙊🙊

He feels slightly inexperienced; I hope he can give more advice in customer shooting action guidance in the future. He's quite talkative and the shooting process was pleasant.

src: 小雨伞买保险，靠谱吗?

chosen.text: Is it reliable for a small umbrella to buy insurance?

src: 小雨伞是一个互联网的保险经纪平台。

chosen.text: Little Umbrella is an internet-based insurance brokerage platform.

src: 从设置条件来看：按照《保险经纪机构监管规定(2015年修订)》提示来看，成为保险经纪公司的，必须满足三个关键词：股东、发起人最近3年无重大违法记录、最低限额为人民币5000万元才可以成立、必须经过中国保监会同意。

chosen.text: Under the conditions stipulated: According to the "Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Insurance Brokers (Revised in 2015)", to become an insurance broker company, one must meet three key terms: no major illegal records over the past three years for shareholders or initiators, a minimum requirement of RMB 50 million, and must obtain approval from the China Insurance Regulatory Commission (CIRC).

src: 这三条其实就是很苛刻的，总结起来就是要有实力，要经过银保监会（监管全国内的保险公司、银行）的国家权威部门批准、股东要有良好的作风，作为保险经纪公司的小雨伞保险，投保者是不用过多质疑小雨伞保险是正规的与否，毕竟有这3条门槛，不是什么保险公司都能达到的。

chosen.text: These are quite stringent requirements. In summary, they entail having the capability, being approved by the national authority department—the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (which oversees all insurance companies and banks in the country)—and having good corporate governance from shareholders. For Xiaoyuxia Insurance, an insurance brokerage company, policyholders don’t have to question whether Xiaoyuxia Insurance is legitimate or not since there are these three thresholds; not every insurance company can meet them.

src: 在这一点上，还不错，是值得信赖的。

chosen.text: So far, so good, and trustworthy.

src: 从保险产品来看：小雨伞保险就是一个保险超市，很多公司的明星重疾险都在这家平台上出售，如最新上架的和泰超级玛丽5号重疾险，理赔方和承保方都是和泰人寿，小雨伞保险只是第三方中介，不用质疑它的靠谱性。

chosen.text: From insurance products standpoint, Xiaoyushan Insurance can be seen as an insurance supermarket where many companies' star critical illness insurance products are sold on this platform, such as the latest HuaTai Super Mary 5th Generation Critical Illness Insurance, with both the claimant and insurer being HuaTai Life Insurance. Xiaoyushan Insurance is merely a third-party intermediary; there's no need to doubt its reliability.

src: 从缴费模式来看：互联网平台的产品，因为少了营业网点的经营费用，和业务员工资的成本，所以互联网产品普遍性价比比较高，而且缴费方式灵活，支持月缴，减轻投保人的缴费压力，同时可以最大限度的撬动保险的杠杆。

chosen.text: From a payment model standpoint: the products of internet platforms have lower operating costs due to the absence of branch expenses and employee salaries, making them generally more cost-efficient. They also offer flexible payment options, supporting monthly payments, which reduces the financial burden on policyholders. This approach maximizes the leverage of insurance products.

src: 这点还是非常不错的。

chosen.text: This is still quite good.

src: 可以考虑。

chosen.text: It can be considered.

src: 从业务员专业度来看：这点尤为重要，因为保险是一个专业度要求非常强的行业，很多互联网产品客户可以自己投保，这种就会存在很多的误区，在健康告知和职业这块，非保险从业人员往往在投保的时候会添加自己的主观意识，觉得自己健康或者符合，这样容易存在很多理赔隐患，有可能被拒赔的风险。

chosen.text: From an insurance professional standpoint: This is particularly important because insurance is a highly professional industry, and many internet product customers can now self-insure. This can lead to numerous misconceptions, especially in health disclosures and occupation categories. Non-insurance professionals often add their subjective opinions when purchasing insurance, believing they are healthy or meet the criteria, which can create potential risks for claims. There is a risk of being denied coverage as a result.

src: 我自己曾在“腾讯微保”（和小雨伞一样，也是互联网保险经纪平台）做过保险电话销售，非常负责任的告诉大家。

chosen.text: I used to do insurance telephone sales at Tencent Micro Insurance (similar to Xiaoyushuang, an internet insurance brokerage platform), and I feel it is responsible to share this with you.

src: 互联网的保险是真的，也靠谱，不靠谱的是人，互联网渠道没有专业的从业人员，也有很多的销售误导。

chosen.text: Internet insurance is real and reliable, but unreliable are people. There are no professional agents in the internet channels, and there is also much misleading sales.

src: 比如：1元保险保600万，买保险送手机，免费领取6万重疾保额，这些营销策略没有错，可是却避重就轻，不会告诉投保人，首月1元，次月是需要按正常收费的，几十到200不等，很多客户扣费一两年自己买的是个啥不清楚。

chosen.text: For example: 1 yuan insurance covers 6 million, buy insurance and get a phone, free to receive a 60,000 critical illness coverage. These marketing strategies are not wrong, but they gloss over important details and do not inform the policyholder that the first month is 1 yuan, but the second month and onwards will be charged at normal rates, which can range from several tens of yuan to 200 yuan per month. Many customers are unclear about what they are actually purchasing after deducting fees for a few years.

src: 以为可以花1块钱，保险公司赔600万（天下掉馅饼）。

chosen.text: Thinking you can pay 1 yuan and get compensation of 6 million (a free lunch falling from the sky).

src: 免费送手机，是保单尾号比如6666，8888这种特殊保单号段才送的，并且如果中奖短信发出，自己不兑换，也没有人提醒的。

chosen.text: Free phones are given out for special policy numbers like 6666 or 8888 in the policy tail number, and if the winning message is sent but not exchanged by the recipient, no one will remind them.

src: （这对于投保人来说，就又是一个坑）免费领6万重疾保额，是短期的，如果只靠这个，没有其他商业险，万一真发生重疾，6万能干嘛，解决不了问题，以后的生活开始裸奔。

chosen.text: (This is another trap for policyholders) Free to receive a 60,000 yuan critical illness insurance coverage, it's temporary. If relying solely on this, without other commercial insurance, if a serious illness does occur, what can 60,000 yuan do? It won't solve the problem, and one's future life will start living in poverty.

src: 目前对于互联网保险销售的误导，国家也在严厉打击。

chosen.text: Currently, the state is also cracking down heavily on misleading sales of internet insurance.

src: 所以综合来看，平台是没有问题，产品也没有问题，有问题的是业务员的专业度和职业操守。

chosen.text: So in summary, the platform is fine and the product is fine; the issue lies with the professionalism and ethical conduct of the sales personnel.

src: 建议题主综合慎重考虑，其实很多线下保险经纪公司的产品更广，客户可以选择的机会和产品更多，有些产品的性价比也优于互联网产品。

chosen.text: It is recommended that the main topic consider carefully that, in fact, many offline insurance brokerage companies offer a wider range of products, providing customers with more choices and options, and some products have better value for money compared to internet-based products.

src: 我自己就帮助过59位互联网客户，承保线下产品，保费每个人节约2000-3000元/年。

chosen.text: I have helped 59 internet clients by underwriting offline products, saving each an average of 2000-3000 yuan per year.

src: 如果大家有什么疑问，欢迎与我沟通和交流。

chosen.text: If you have any questions, you are welcome to communicate and communicate with me.

src: 我：明亚保险经纪人，有过3年企业管理培训经验，服务过近千家企业用户，合作超过100家保险公司，在投保前，我会从客户需求出发，为客户量身定制保险产品，投保中，为客户货比三家，尽力为客户争取最好的核保结果，投保后，为客户做保单整理，保单托管，让客户放心无忧。

chosen.text: I am Mingya Insurance Broker, with three years of experience in enterprise management training, serving over a thousand corporate users, and collaborating with more than 100 insurance companies. Before purchasing, I tailor insurance products to meet the client's needs. During the purchase process, I help clients compare policies to secure the best underwriting results for them. Afterward, I handle policy organization and custody, ensuring peace of mind for the clients.

src: 跟每个客户一起终身成长。

chosen.text: Grow with each customer for life.

src: 希望我的回答能够对题主有所帮助！

chosen.text: I hope my response can be of help to you!

src: 根据保险监管部门的定义，互联网保险就是投保人点击投保链接后，可以自主完成所有的投保流程的保险业务。

chosen.text: According to the definition by insurance regulatory authorities, internet insurance refers to insurance business where policyholders can independently complete all the procedures of an insurance policy after clicking on an insurance link.

src: 在这个过程中，投保人不需要签字，保险顾问也不需要签字，所有步骤全部都可以由投保人自主完成。

chosen.text: Throughout this process, the policyholder does not need to sign, nor does the insurance consultant need to sign; all steps can be completed autonomously by the policyholder.

src: 虽然互联网保险的投保没太有“仪式感”，甚至可能连打印版的纸质合同都没有，但是这丝毫不影响电子版合同的有效性与法律效力。

chosen.text: Although internet insurance applications may lack “ceremony” and even lack printed paper contracts, this does not in any way affect the validity and legal effect of electronic contracts.

src: 这种模式，有点类似于“电话销售”一般的流水线作业，但如此购买保险也会有一个致命的问题，那就是——后续的服务可能会跟不上。

chosen.text: This model is somewhat akin to a conveyor belt in telemarketing, but such insurance purchases also come with a fatal flaw: subsequent services may not keep up.

src: 保险通常是一份长达几十年的长期契约，我们在购买保险的时候，是不是应该认真思考一下，我们所选择的这个“中介”，是不是一个可以与我们长期相伴、在很多年后也会给我们提供服务的“保险中介人”呢？

src: 越南人民报网 - 越南政府总理范明正出席第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛

chosen.text: Vietnam News Online – Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh attends the third Vietnam National Forum on Digital Technology Enterprises

src: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。

chosen.text: Two major meetings were held during the third Vietnam National Forum on Digital Technology Enterprises Development, focusing on discussions around digital technology enterprises and Vietnam's national digital transformation, as well as the impact of digital technology enterprises on economic recovery and development both during and after the pandemic.

src: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。

chosen.text: Minister of Communication and Mass Media Nguyen Manh Hung stated that in 2021, although the coronavirus disease was still spreading, the number of digital technology enterprises in Vietnam and their revenue grew, reaching nearly 10%.

src: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。

chosen.text: In 2021, typical digital products in Vietnam were cultivated to address the major challenges the country faced, and many digital products had already gone global. The ranking of Vietnamese digital technologies had improved.

src: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。

chosen.text: Minister Ruang Meng Xiong called on digital technology enterprises to shoulder the responsibility of developing the country’s digital transformation platform, and said that taking on the task of developing these national digital platforms means assuming a national mission.

src: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。

chosen.text: On the forum, leaders from various departments and state organs, enterprises, organizations, and individuals that are researching, developing, applying, and transferring digital technologies shared breakthrough ideas and solutions for mobilizing and aggregating societal resources to develop Vietnamese tech enterprises, working together to drive the country's digital transformation, as well as post-pandemic economic recovery.

src: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。

chosen.text: Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized in his speech at the forum that digital transformation is the inevitable path for the world and an objective requirement for development.

src: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。

chosen.text: Digital transformation has become a global issue, serving the entire population, and therefore requires mobilizing the participation of the entire population.

src: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。

chosen.text: People and enterprises are the core, subject, goal, and driving force of digital transformation.

src: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。

chosen.text: Therefore, all policies must be for the people and the enterprises.

src: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。

chosen.text: Premier Fan Mintang emphasized that digital transformation should embody national spirit and should be driven by internal strength, strategy, long-term and decisive factors, with external forces being important and breakthroughs.

src: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。

chosen.text: He believes that digital transformation needs to drive deeper and more sustainable development, participating in the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic, economic recovery and development, preparing for subsequent changes, overcoming resource depletion, promoting green transformation, and developing green energy.

src: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。

chosen.text: Digital transformation involves participating in the establishment of databases that protect and promote national cultural values, historical traditions, and national customs, and driving digital transformations in sectors such as banking, taxation, land management and development, and logistics.

src: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。

chosen.text: The greatest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and ensure the growing prosperity of the nation.

src: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。

chosen.text: Premier Fu Mingzheng called for increased leadership and guidance from all levels of government, organs, and enterprises in the development of digital technology to raise awareness of digital transformation, continue to formulate and improve systems for digital transformation, enhance state management, and drive the development of digital technology enterprises with respect, communication, listening, positivity, and initiative.

src: 论坛期间，范明正总理出席了2021年“越南制造”优秀数字产品奖颁奖仪式及“越南制造”数字产品展开幕式。

chosen.text: During the forum, Prime Minister Van Manh attended the ceremony for the 2021 award of excellent digital products under the "Vietnam Manufacturing" brand and the opening ceremony of the "Vietnam Manufacturing" digital products exhibition.

chosen.text: Wang Cheng pointed out that hosting a talent summit is an important measure to implement the spirit of the Central Conference on Talent Work and the 12th Party Congress of the Province, showcasing Hunan's genuine commitment to valuing, seeking out, and utilizing talent.

src: 湖南有识才爱才敬才的优良传统、助力人才发展的广阔平台、实现美好生活的环境条件，近年来深入实施人才引领发展战略，以芙蓉人才行动计划为牵引，构建起引育留用全链条人才工作格局，成为了人才成长成就的沃土、创新创业的热土、宜居宜业的乐土。

chosen.text: Hunan has a fine tradition of valuing talent, respecting talent, and nurturing talent, as well as broad platforms for developing talent and favorable conditions for achieving a better life. In recent years, it has deeply implemented a strategy to lead development through talent, with the Fenghuo Talent Action Plan serving as a driving force. This has established a comprehensive talent work pattern that covers recruitment, cultivation, retention, and utilization. As a result, it has become a fertile ground for talent growth and achievement, a hotbed for innovation and entrepreneurship, and a desirable place to live and work.

src: 当前，湖南正在全面落实“三高四新”战略定位和使命任务，将进一步广开引贤纳才之门，为人才创新创业出台更优政策、集中更多资源、创造更好条件，期待各界优秀人才共同为湖南高质量发展聚智汇力。

chosen.text: Currently, Hunan is fully implementing the strategic positioning and mission of “Three Highs and Four New Things,” and will further open doors for attracting talents and fostering entrepreneurship, offering better policies, concentrating more resources, and creating better conditions to support talent innovation and entrepreneurship. It looks forward to outstanding talents from all sectors coming together to pool their wisdom and efforts for high-quality development in Hunan.
