src: 长江干流实现水上绿色综合服务区全覆盖-新华网

chosen.text: The Yangtze River main stem achieves full coverage of waterborne green comprehensive service areas - Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社武汉12月11日电（记者王贤）重庆市涪陵水上绿色综合服务区10日如期建成投入运营，这是继8日四川省泸州水上绿色综合服务区挂牌运营后，长江上游正式运营的第2个水上绿色综合服务区。

chosen.text: Xinhua Wuhan, Dec 11 (Xinhua reporter Wang Xian) The Wulong waterborne integrated service area for green development in Chongqing was completed and put into operation on Sunday, the second such service area for green water transport services officially operating downstream of the Yangtze River after the Liulong area in Sichuan Province was inaugurated on Saturday.

src: 至此，水上绿色综合服务区已覆盖长江上、中、下游。

chosen.text: So far, the water-green integrated service area has covered the upper, middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River.

src: 交通运输部长江航务管理局副局长邱健华介绍说，此前，湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江苏等省份已在长江中游、下游建成运行10个水上绿色综合服务区，得到了广大船员的认可，为推进长江航运高质量发展发挥了重要作用。

chosen.text: Qiu Jianhua, Deputy Director of the Yangtze Navigation Administration under the Ministry of Transport, introduced that so far, ten green comprehensive service areas for waterborne transport have been built and put into operation in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River in provinces such as Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, and Jiangsu, which have received widespread recognition from crew members and played an important role in promoting the high-quality development of Yangtze River shipping.

src: 水上绿色综合服务区全覆盖是长江绿色航运建设的又一里程碑事件，长江船舶污染物接收、航运服务能力得到显著提升。

chosen.text: The full coverage of green integrated service areas on water is another milestone in the construction of green shipping on the Yangtze River, significantly enhancing the reception and handling capacity of ship pollutants on the Yangtze River.

src: 据介绍，水上绿色综合服务区是为广大船舶、船员提供全方位生产、生活服务，帮助广大船员解决“急难愁盼”问题的重要设施。

chosen.text: According to the introduction, the green integrated service area on water is an important facility that provides comprehensive production and living services for ships and seafarers, helping to address the "urgent, difficult, and concerning" issues faced by seafarers.

src: 此次建成运行的长江上游两处水上绿色综合服务区，集生活服务、生产服务和政务服务为一体，以绿色环保为主题，以船舶维修与船舶应急救援服务为特色，实现港内船舶“一次靠泊、多项服务 ” ， 将使得常年航行在长江的船员工作更高效、生活更便捷。

chosen.text: The two newly built and operational green comprehensive service areas on the Yangtze River's upper reaches integrate living services, production services, and government services under one roof, with a theme focused on green and environmental protection. The areas specialize in ship maintenance and emergency rescue services, aiming to enable ships in port to receive "multiple services in one berthing," which will make it more efficient for crew members who undertake year-round navigation on the Yangtze River, and their lives more convenient.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 2022-01-17 多维 亲中共媒体多维报道：中美关系最新消息：最新卫星图像显示，美国三艘航母正在中国周边集结；美媒还披露，美国海军武器库中最强大的武器之一罕见访问关岛，对印太地区美国的盟友与敌手释放重要信号。

chosen.text: US deploys three aircraft carriers near China; US Navy's most powerful weapon makes rare visit to Guam, sending important signals to America's allies and adversaries in the Indo-Pacific region.

src: 据中国智库“南海战略态势感知平台”消息，1月9日，卫星在巴拉巴克海峡附近发现了美军“卡尔·文森”号（USS Carl Vinson）航母。

chosen.text: According to the China think tank "Nanhai Strategic Situation Awareness Platform," on January 9th, a satellite detected the USS Carl Vinson aircraft carrier of the US Navy in the Bashi Channel vicinity.

src: 巴拉巴克海峡连通南海和苏禄海，是西太平洋第一岛链上的战略要地。

chosen.text: The Baracoa Strait connects the South China Sea and Sulu Sea and is a strategic location in the First Island Chain of the Western Pacific.

src: 该平台预计，“卡尔·文森”号将前往南海部署。

chosen.text: The platform expects that the USS Carl Vinson will deploy to the South China Sea.

src: 这是“卡尔·文森”号航母首次搭载F-35C战斗机和CMV-22“鱼鹰”舰载运输机进行部署。

chosen.text: This is the first deployment of the aircraft carrier USS Carl Vinson to carry F-35C fighter jets and CMV-22 "Osprey" deck-based transport aircraft.

src: 现在正在太平洋上游弋的美军航母，除了“卡尔·文森”号外，还有1月3日从美国出发的“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号（USS Abraham Lincoln）航母。

chosen.text: Currently sailing in the Pacific are US Navy aircraft carriers other than the USS Carl Vinson, which set sail from the United States on January 3rd with the USS Abraham Lincoln.

src: “林肯”号也首次搭载了F-35C舰载机中队，该中队隶属美国海军陆战队的第314战斗机攻击中队。

chosen.text: The USS "Lincoln" also carried an F-35C carrier squadron for the first time, which is part of the Marine Corps' 314th Fighter Attack Wing.

src: 除了上述两艘航母外，目前美国海军部署在亚太地区的还有停靠在日本横须贺的“里根”号（USS Ronald Reagan）航母。

chosen.text: In addition to the two aircraft carriers mentioned above, currently deployed in the Asia-Pacific region by the US Navy is the aircraft carrier USS Ronald Reagan, which is berthed in Yokosuka, Japan.

src: 航母战斗群中还包括“尚普兰湖”号导弹巡洋舰、“斯托克达尔”号导弹驱逐舰等。

chosen.text: Included in the Carrier Battle Group are the guided-missile cruiser Lake Superior and the guided-missile destroyer Sterkeveld.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 2022年1月17日，“南海战略态势感知平台”公布最新卫星图片，显示美军三艘航母正在中国周边集结。

chosen.text: U.S.S. carriers are gathering around China, the most powerful weapon rarely visits Guam on January 17, 2022, the Yangtze Strategic Positioning Platform released the latest satellite images showing three U.S.S. carriers are gathering around China.

src: （微博@南海战略态势感知） 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 2022年1月17日，美军舰载运输机CMV-22B飞行路线。

chosen.text: U.S. carriers are gathering the most powerful weapons around China to reach Guam on January 17, 2022, the U.S. Navy's shipping carrier CMV-22B flight route.

src: （微博@南海战略态势感知） 另据美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）1月17日报道，美国海军武器库中最强大的武器之一上周末罕见地访问了关岛。

chosen.text: (CNN, Weibo @SouthChinaSeaStrategicSituationalAwareness) According to a report by CNN on January 17, one of the US Navy's most powerful weapons visited Guam last weekend, an unusual occurrence.

src: 载有20枚三叉戟（Trident）弹道导弹和数十枚核弹头的俄亥俄级核潜艇“内华达号”（USS Nevada）上周六（1月15日）驶入美国关岛海军基地。

chosen.text: The USS Nevada (a Ohio-class nuclear submarine carrying 20 Trident ballistic missiles and dozens of nuclear warheads) entered the US Naval Base in Guam last Saturday (January 15th).

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 分析称，这是向印度-太平洋地区日益紧张的局势中的盟友和敌人发出了一个信号。

chosen.text: Three US aircraft carriers gather near China's periphery; its most powerful weapon visits Guam for a rare occasion. Analysis says this is sending a signal to allies and adversaries in the region as tensions in the Indian-Pacific area rise.

src: 这是美国弹道导弹潜艇自2016年以来首次访问关岛，也是自20世纪80年代以来第二次公开访问关岛。

chosen.text: This is the first visit to Guam by an American ballistic missile submarine since 2016 and the second public visit to Guam since the 1980s.

src: 美三航母集结中国周边 最强大武器罕见访问关岛 中国近年来在南沙群岛修建大批军事设施。

chosen.text: Three U.S. aircraft carriers gather near China's periphery, and its most powerful weapon visits Guam for a rare occasion. China has been constructing a large number of military facilities in the Spratly Islands in recent years.

src: 图为中国在南沙群岛的永暑岛。

chosen.text: Image of Yongshu Reef in the Paracel Islands belonging to China.

src: （南海研究论坛） 美国海军在声明中称，俄亥俄级核潜艇“内华达号”此次对关岛的访问加强了美国和该地区盟友之间的合作，展示了美国的能力、灵活性、战备状态，以及对印太地区安全与稳定的持续承诺。

chosen.text: (The South China Sea Research Forum) The U.S. Navy stated in its declaration that the visit to Guam by the Ohio-class submarine USS Nevada enhanced cooperation between the United States and its regional allies, showcased the capabilities, flexibility, and readiness of the U.S., as well as its ongoing commitment to the security and stability of the Indo-Pacific region.

src: 弹道导弹潜艇通常被称为“雷鸣潜艇”（Boomer submarine）。

chosen.text: Ballistic missile submarines are typically referred to as "boomers" (Boomer submarine).

src: 美国海军舰队中14艘“雷鸣潜艇”的行踪通常是被严格保密的。

chosen.text: The whereabouts of 14 "Reaper submarines" in the U.S. Navy fleet are typically tightly classified.

src: 围绕着弹道导弹潜艇的秘密使“雷鸣潜艇”成为“核三位一体中最重要的生存武器”，这一体系还包括位于美国本土的发射井弹道导弹，以及B-2和B-52等可携带核弹头的轰炸机。

chosen.text: The secrecy surrounding ballistic missile submarines makes them "the most important survivable weapon" in the "nuclear triad," which also includes land-based intercontinental ballistic missiles in the United States, as well as B-2 and B-52 bombers that can carry nuclear warheads.

src: 跟朋友聊起最近Meta大跌 26%，市值蒸发 2510 亿美元，扎克伯格回应「面临前所未有的竞争」，原因为何？

chosen.text: Talking to friends about Meta's recent drop of 26%, losing $251 billion in market value, Zuckerberg responded with "facing unprecedented competition." Why was this the case?

src: Meta（原 Facebook）实质是一家广告公司，收入主要来自于广告，今时今日赚钱的广告公司，自己是有流量渠道的。

chosen.text: Meta (formerly Facebook) is essentially an ad company, primarily generating revenue from ads, and today's ad companies that make money have their own traffic channels.

src: Facebook，Instagram，Whatsapp 等等，无论什么样的功能定位，都是 Meta 的流量渠道。

chosen.text: Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, etc., are all traffic channels for Meta regardless of their function.

src: 不仅如此，Meta 还是最大的”广告联盟”,很多 App 外接 Meta 的广告，通过 Meta 的广告平台是实现变现。

chosen.text: Moreover, Meta is also the largest "ad network," with many apps connecting their ads to Meta's platform for monetization.

src: 但是，时代变了。

chosen.text: But times have changed.

src: 第一，因为苹果隐私政策的调整，Meta 很难再拿到用户的数据信息，影响了广告投放的效率。

chosen.text: First, due to Apple's privacy policy changes, Meta has found it difficult to obtain user data, which impacts the efficiency of its advertising campaigns.

src: 苹果现在的隐私政策对用户很友好，会很明显的提示用户是否允许 App 获取自己的信息，大多数人的正常反应肯定是不允许。

chosen.text: Apple's current privacy policy is user-friendly and clearly prompts users whether to allow an app to access their information. Most people’s normal reaction would be to refuse.

src: 接下来如果 Google 再捅一刀，对 Meta 的收入影响还会更大。

chosen.text: Next, if Google cuts off Meta again, the impact on Meta's revenue would be even greater.

src: 第二，以前 Meta 的收入增长里的中国因素也弱化了（这个因素的比重不确定有多高，但确实存在）。

chosen.text: Second, the China factor in Meta’s revenue growth has weakened (the weight of this factor is uncertain but it does exist).

src: 大家平时都知道 Meta 在中国是没有业务的，但是这个理解并不准确。

chosen.text: Everyone knows that Meta does not have operations in China, but this understanding is not accurate.

src: 每年 Meta 至少10%的收入都来自中国，主要是中国做出海业务的公司贡献的。

chosen.text: Meta earns at least 10% of its revenue annually from China, mainly contributed by companies that have gone global from China.

src: Meta 在香港的办公室大概几百人，在大陆还有几大代理商。

chosen.text: Meta's office in Hong Kong has around several hundred people, and there are several major agents in mainland China.

src: 中国公司想要拓展海外市场，Meta 都是绕不过的广告渠道，烧的钱大多都给了 Meta。

chosen.text: Chinese companies want to expand into overseas markets, and Meta is an advertising channel they cannot avoid spending money on, with most of their spending going to Meta.

src: 有意思的是，现在字节的 TT 是 Meta 主要的竞争对手之一，但是前两年 Meta 从字节身上可赚到不少钱。

chosen.text: Interestingly, Toutiao is now one of ByteDance's main competitors for Meta, but Meta made quite a bit of money from ByteDance in the past two years.

src: 国内各个代理都在帮字节去 Meta 那里投广告，Meta 大中华区的业绩也很不错。

chosen.text: All domestic agents are helping ByteDance advertise with Meta, and Meta's performance in Greater China is also doing well.

src: 最近我没有专门去了解，但是肯定不会比之前好。

chosen.text: I haven't specifically gone to learn about it recently, but it certainly won't be better than before.

src: 中国公司在海外大规模烧钱的阶段已经过去了。

chosen.text: The phase of large-scale spending by Chinese companies overseas is over.

src: 第三，新的流量渠道拓展不顺利。

chosen.text: Third, new traffic channels have not been expanded smoothly.

src: Facebook 越来越老了，新的包括 TT 在内的平台，都不在 Meta 手中。

chosen.text: Facebook is getting older, with new platforms like TT not in Meta's hands.

src: 最大的问题不仅仅是收入下滑，而是缺乏增长预期。

chosen.text: The biggest problem is not just a decline in income but a lack of growth expectations.

src: 资本市场不仅仅看中收入，更重要的是看未来的预期怎么样。

chosen.text: The capital market looks not just at current income but more importantly at what the future expectations are.

src: 很显然，Meta 的预期是不够的。

chosen.text: Clearly, Meta's expectations are insufficient.

src: 为了给市场讲出新的故事，扎克伯格讲了 “元宇宙”.

chosen.text: To tell new stories to the market, Zuckerberg talked about the "metaverse."

src: 元宇宙确实应该是未来的方向之一，但是元宇宙的实现周期比较长，这个故事在这两三年应该不足以支撑起 Meta 的市值。

chosen.text: The Metaverse should indeed be one of the future directions, but the timeline to realize the Metaverse is long, and this story may not be sufficient to justify Meta's current market valuation over the next couple of years.

src: 所以未来这两年，应该是 Meta 比较艰难的时期。

chosen.text: So the next two years should be a difficult period for Meta.

src: 别看脸书现在非常的风光，每年也有1,000亿到2,000亿美元的收入，实际上脸书现在危机感非常强，跟其他的互联网企业和高科技公司相比，没有什么好的安全的护城河。

chosen.text: Despite Facebook now being very prosperous, it brings in anywhere from $100 billion to $200 billion in annual revenue, it actually feels very threatened. Compared to other internet companies and technology firms, it has no good safe moat.

src: 虽然他的几款社交软件现在的日活比较高，也是主流的社交软件，比如Facebook，WhatsApp等等，但是面对tiktok的快速发展，脸书也没有什么信心，颠覆之间也就是眨眼的功夫。

chosen.text: Although his several social apps have high daily active users and are mainstream social platforms like Facebook and WhatsApp, Facebook lacks confidence in the rapid development of TikTok. Disruption can happen in an instant.

src: 而搞元宇宙这个可望而不可及的概念，短时间之内完全没有成功的希望，因此脸书非常的危险，这也是为什么扎克伯格又是换公司的名字，又是不停的寻找新的赛道的根本原因，但是我觉得他的赛道选择是错的，是一条不归路 以上是我的一些思考，供参考。

chosen.text: While the concept of the Metaverse, which is out of reach in the short term and therefore has no hope of success, makes Facebook extremely dangerous, which is why Zuckerberg keeps changing his company’s name and constantly searching for new opportunities. However, I believe that the path he chose is wrong and leads to a dead end. These are some of my thoughts for reference.

src: 第十七条 国家对注册消防工程师资格实行注册执业管理制度。

chosen.text: Section 17: The state implements a registration management system for registered fire engineers.

src: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。

chosen.text: Persons holding qualifications for Registered Fire Engineer at Level I or Level II shall practice under the name of the corresponding level Registered Fire Engineer after registration.

src: 第十八条 公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。

chosen.text: Eighteen. The Registration Approval Department for First-Class Registered Fire Engineers is the Fire Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security.

src: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。

chosen.text: The provincial, autonomous region, and municipal public security fire protection bureaus are the departments responsible for registering second-level registered fire engineers, and they also undertake the preliminary review of applications for first-level registered fire engineers.

src: 第十九条 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。

chosen.text: Article 19: A person who obtains a first-level or second-level registered fire engineer’s certificate and applies for registration shall be employed by a fire technology service institution that has been approved or a key unit in terms of fire safety, and shall submit the application materials through the public security fire institution of the unit where he/she is employed (if the employing unit is an enterprise, through the enterprise to the public security fire institution of its place of business registration).

src: 第二十条 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次 性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。

chosen.text: Twenty: Within five working days of receiving an applicant's registration application, the public security fire department of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the central government shall inform the applicant in writing, if the materials submitted are incomplete or do not conform to legal form, of all the content that needs to be corrected; failure to provide such notice within the stipulated time will be deemed as acceptance from the date the application materials were received.

src: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。

chosen.text: For registration applications that are accepted or not accepted, a written voucher shall be issued bearing the dedicated seal of the public security fire institution at this level and noting the date.

src: 第二十一条 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。

chosen.text: Twenty-first: The public security fire department of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall complete the preliminary review of the application materials for first-class registered fire engineer qualifications and the registration approval for second-class registered fire engineers within 20 working days after accepting the application, according to the prescribed conditions and procedures. It shall then submit the application materials for first-class registered fire engineer qualifications and the preliminary review opinion to the Public Security Fire Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

src: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。

chosen.text: The Ministry of Public Security's Fire Bureau shall make a decision on whether to approve within 20 working days from the date of receiving the application materials submitted by the provincial public security fire institutions and their preliminary review opinions.

src: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。

chosen.text: Where an approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed period, the extension of the period and the reasons for such extension shall be notified to the applicant.

src: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。

chosen.text: For decisions not to approve, reasons should be provided in writing, and the applicant should be informed of the right to apply for administrative review or bring an administrative lawsuit according to law.

src: 第二十二条 注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。

chosen.text: The department responsible for approving registration shall issue and deliver the corresponding level of registration certificate within ten working days of making its approval decision.

src: 第二十三条 注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。

chosen.text: The validity period of each registration certificate is 3 years.

src: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。

chosen.text: The registration certificate is the practice credential for a registered fire engineer of a certain level valid within its validity period, and it shall be kept and used by the registered fire engineer himself/herself.

src: 第二十四条 申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。

chosen.text: Article 24: Initial registration shall be applied for within one year from the date of obtaining the first or second-level registered fire engineer qualification certificate.

src: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。

chosen.text: To apply for initial registration upon overdue, one must meet the continuing education requirements stipulated in this regulation.

src: 初始注册、延续注册、变更注册、注销注册和不予注册等注册管理的具体办法，由公安部另行规定。

chosen.text: Specific procedures for initial registration, continuation of registration, changes to registration, cancellation of registration, and non-registration will be regulated by the Ministry of Public Security separately.

src: 第二十五条 继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。

chosen.text: Continued education is a mandatory condition for continuing registration, re-registration, and delayed initial registration of registered fire engineers.

src: 在每个注册有效期内，各级别注册消防工程师应当按照规定完成相应的继续教育。

chosen.text: During each valid registration period, registered fire engineers at all levels shall complete the corresponding continuing education as required.

src: 第二十六条 注册审批部门应当及时向社会公告注册消防工程师注册有关情况，建立注册消防工程师诚信档案，对其执业活动实行信用管理。

chosen.text: Article 26 The department responsible for reviewing and approving registration shall promptly make public information regarding the registration of fire engineers, establish an archive on the professional conduct of registered fire engineers, and implement credit management of their practice activities.

src: 第二十七条 各级注册消防工程师资格的注册管理部门，应当严格执行《中华人民共和国行政许可法》有关规定。

chosen.text: Article 27: The registration management departments for registered fire engineers at all levels shall strictly enforce the provisions of the Administrative Licensing Law of the People's Republic of China.

src: 中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习圆满结束-新华网

chosen.text: The joint medical exercise "Peace Rescue 2021" between Chinese and Vietnamese armed forces concludes successfully - Xinhua News Agency

src: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜 滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。

chosen.text: On the morning of December 12, the Chinese delegation participating in the Joint Exercise of the People's Liberation Army and the People's Republic of China (PRC) for the Joint Exercise of the People's Liberation Army and the Vietnamese People's Liberation Army (PLAC-2021) returned safely to Guangxi Province of China, marking the successful completion of the seven-day exercise.

src: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。

chosen.text: In this joint speech, the two militaries focused on the important topic of humanitarian medical rescue, closely aligned with the mission of the National Guard Rescue and Death Assistance Mission, and successfully improved the security capabilities of the two militaries by completing joint command, joint field rescue, batch wounded disposal, and so on, in accordance with practical standards.

src: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。

chosen.text: The exercise results were acknowledged by both the Chinese and Vietnamese militaries.

src: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。

chosen.text: Chairman of the Vietnamese Exercise Guidance Committee and Deputy Director-General of the Logistics Bureau of the Vietnam People’s Army, General Nguyen Hung Son, said at the closing ceremony that through the exercise, Vietnamese medical personnel have learned knowledge on exercise organization and professional activities from Chinese medical personnel and also seen the medical and support equipment of the Chinese side.

src: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。

chosen.text: The results of the exercise demonstrated the professional capabilities of the military medical forces of both countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

src: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。

chosen.text: Chairman of China's Coordinating Group, Deputy Director of the Ministry of Health of Logistics and Security of the Central Military Commission, Chen Chunming, said that the exercise was a very important milestone in pioneering innovative practices based on the success of the Joint Diagnostic Exercise in 2018.

src: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。

chosen.text: During the exercise, the People's Liberation Army of China donated medical protective masks, medical protective clothing, rapid nucleic acid testing instruments, and other health prevention materials to the Vietnamese People's Army.
